- Reinforcements @technology_ayyubids/military-wing-reinforcement-1.png@: Good against horse Civs (MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP)
- Master Smiths @technology_ayyubids/military-wing-master-smiths-1.png@: Good against archers Civs

- Logistics @technology_ayyubids/culture-wing-logistics-1.png@: Save for Castle age up if against Civs that prioritize Relics, otherwise, save for Imperial age up
- Advancement @technology_ayyubids/culture-wing-advancement-1.png@: Save for later (when a quick age up can be decisive)

*** Try to not completely exhaust berries. Future age-up will provide bonus to berry bushes that still remain

@age/age_3.webp@ Age up to Castle with appropriate Wing

- Growth @technology_ayyubids/economic-wing-growth-1.png@: Get 8 villagers on age up, best in 90% of scenarios. Rally @resource/rally.png@ to berries @resource/berrybush.png@(MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP)

- Advancement @technology_ayyubids/culture-wing-advancement-1.png@: Save for when a quick age up can be decisive
Rally villagers @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to wood @resource/resource_wood.png@ until 12 (Build @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ when necessary)
***MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP***
Immediately queue Camel Lancers @unit_ayyubids/camel-lancer-3.webp@ and harass
Build Mosque @building_religious/mosque.webp@ (consider building 2) and get relics @resource/relics.png@ (1 Relic = 2 Villagers on Gold)
***If opponent is massing units and playing aggressively, prioritize military production buildings
Build blacksmith @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ get appropriate upgrades (@technology_military/iron-undermesh.png@ + @technology_military/bloomery.png@ +  etc)
Upgrade to Veteran Camel Lancers @unit_ayyubids/camel-lancer-3.webp@ at stables @building_military/stable.png@

Instead, build barracks @building_military/barracks.png@ and Ghulam @unit_abbasid/ghulam-3.png@ to break out. Add @building_military/archery-range.png@ @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.png@ to support.
Camel Lancers @unit_ayyubids/camel-lancer-3.png@ in general are better because than Ghulam @unit_abbasid/ghulam-3.png@ because you can more easily harass and keep your opponent on defense.
Don't forget to build siege @building_military/siege-workshop.png@ units, specifically Manjaniq's @unit_ayyubids/manjaniq-3.png@

As for pressure: keep responding to it. You are 2@building_economy/town-center.png@ so if you survive and don't lose too many @unit_worker/villager.png@ you will eventually win with eco.
Aggressive Walling: is key to securing more map. If under a lot of pressure, wall in the opposite of where your opponent is to take more resources.
Use "Akritoi Defense" from @building_byzantines/cistern-1.png@ to arm villagers with defense and spears in case of raids. Build towers on resources.

notes: Use @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ to circle base and find more sheep.
First **3 new villagers** build @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and a @building_economy/house.webp@ near TC.
When resources allow, age up with @landmark_templar/abbey-of-kings.webp@ using the **3 gold villagers**.
Send **2 food villagers → @resource/resource_stone.webp@** and **4 → straggler trees**.
Set TC @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 4 villagers there, then back to sheep.
After mining 100@resource/resource_stone.webp@, send both stone vils → @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
Once 175@resource/resource_wood.webp@ gathered, send the 4 straggler wood vils → @resource/sheep.webp@.
After Feudal age-up: use 4 gold villagers to build @building_lancaster/manor.webp@ to influence @resource/resource_gold.webp@ + @resource/sheep.webp@ (include @resource/resource_wood.webp@ if close).
Scout opponent’s base — if they’re passive, send @unit_lancaster/lord_lancaster.webp@ to harass exposed vils.
If facing early aggression, you can:
- Place Manor beside @resource/resource_wood.webp@ instead for Feudal defense.
- Transition into military production buildings around it.
- Defend with Lords or tower gold if needed.
Continue normal build if safe: maintain **7 gold / 2 wood / rest on food**.
At ~6:20, start @landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@ with **8 food villagers** (send more if pressured).
Place landmark near @resource/resource_gold.webp@ or between gold + woodline.
While landmark builds, set TC @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for remainder of game.
Use 2–3 gold villagers to build 2@building_military/stable.webp@ nearby.
After aging up, eco layout: 10 food / 12 gold / 1 stone / rest wood.
If pressured: use spawned Men-at-Arms + Lords defensively.
Otherwise, pressure with Knights + Lords to gain map control and relics.
Optional tech path: add @building_military/archery-range.webp@ if enemy makes spears/crossbows.
If sheep run out → move to @resource/berrybush.webp@ or external food.
Your 1 stone villager will have enough for another @building_lancaster/manor.webp@ → place near new food source to maintain influence on ≥10 vils.
Always aim for 10+ vils under each manor for best passive bonus.
Keep producing units, complete eco upgrades, and build @building_economy/farm.webp@ clusters around manors.
At this stage, your eco should be extremely strong with relics + manor passive income.
You can close games with Knight/Lord pushes or safely go Imperial depending on map control.

name: BeastyQT Castle Rush with HRE in Season 6 AOE4
author: Lasco senpai

notes: 3 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on food and 3 on gold ASAP. @unit_hre/prelate.png@ moved to inspire ALL gold @unit_worker/villager.png@ and then immediately back to inspire food.  First new @unit_worker/villager.png@ will build @building_economy/house.png@ then @resource/rally.png@@resource/sheep.png@.
should be able to @age/age_2.webp@ here. Once you have 8 @unit_worker/villager.png@ on  @resource/resource_food.png@, @resource/rally.png@ @resource/resource_wood.png@.

@age/age_2.webp@@landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.png@ with 4 @resource/resource_food.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ and rally them back to @resource/resource_food.png@ after.  IMMORTANT to prioritize safety of this landmark first. Try to avoid front facing @landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.png@ as we will be putting our farms here later.

Ideal @landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.png@ would be influencing @resource/resource_food.png@@resource/resource_wood.png@ & @resource/resource_gold.png@, but depending on spawn this will not always be the case. More often, we will only be able to get 2/3 of these resources, so prioritize @resource/resource_food.png@ first (Food is the most inportant for fast castle with HRE) and influence either @resource/resource_wood.png@ or @resource/resource_gold.png@ depensing on your spawn.

After we have found a good spot to palce @landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.webp@, rally to @resource/resource_wood.png@ and move 1 @resource/resource_food.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@. We will be getting the straggler @resource/resource_wood.png@ around our @building_economy/town-center.png@ first.

Once we get 6 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.png@, we should have enough @resource/resource_wood.png@ for our first @building_defensive/outpost.png@ and this will usually be placed close to our @resource/resource_gold.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@. Have 1 @resource/resource_gold.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ build an @building_defensive/outpost.png@. Try to place @building_defensive/outpost.png@ that it covers as much resources as possible.
Have 1 @resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ put down another @building_economy/house.png@. Then back on @resource/resource_wood.png@.
@unit_hre/prelate.webp@ goes inside @landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.png@ as age up is finished.
Take the time to adjust some @unit_worker/villager.png@ numbers as we will be redistributing our @resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ at this time.

We will have 5 @resource/resource_gold.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ once the @building_defensive/outpost.png@ is completed. @building_economy/town-center.png@@resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_food.png@.

4 @resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ will go straight to @resource/resource_stone.png@. DO NOT BUILD A MINING CAMP. They will complete ONE mining cycle and then @resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_food.png@.

2@resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ will build a @building_military/stable.png@/@building_military/barracks.png@ OR build a 2nd @building_defensive/outpost.png@ to cover your resources. Don't do both at this time.

By this time our @resource/resource_stone.webp@@unit_worker/villager.png@ will have finished one cycle of mining and will go on @resource/resource_food.png@. Our 2@unit_worker/villager.png@ that were building @building_military/barracks.png@/@building_military/stable.png@ OR 2nd @building_defensive/outpost.png@ will go back on @resource/resource_wood.png@ (if they were on @building_defensive/outpost.png@ then it may take them longer to get back).

If we decided to go militery buildings, make around 3-5 units as needed but dont go overboard. Remember our goal is to leave @age/age_2.png@ asap and the longer we are fighing we worse our odds of winning.
These are the numbers we are trying to end @age/age_2.webp@ with.
It is now that we will start getting our economy upgrades. start with @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.png@ & @technology_economy/specialized-pick.png@.

START GETTING RELICS@resource/relics.webp@! This is very important and will unfortunately make or brake how your game will go. If you can get the age up even earlier and be safe at the same time even better. We are trying to get a minimum on Two (2) Relics. The more the merrier and the faster you will snowball. If you can secure @resource/sacred_sites.png@ as well please do.

Keep @building_economy/town-center.png@@resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_wood.png@.Start looking to get @technology_economy/forestry.png@ and @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.png@. If you can not leave your base to secure more food start looking to transition into @building_economy/farm.png@. Otherwise, think about getting more @resource/deer.png@ or even @resource/boar.png@ on the map.  Make a @building_economy/market.png@ the first chance you get.

It is at this point you have to play and adapt with that is going on in the game. If you have not built a militery building now is the time to do so. The best army to go as HRE as you hit @age/age_3.webp@ are  @unit_cavalry/knight-2.png@ as there is a good chance no one else has age 3 knights at this time in the game. Use your discretion however, as we are almost always going to be using @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.png@ as our late game comp as that is our best unit once fully upgraded.
The remainder of this guide is going to assume the game is reletively stable for you after 8:00~

If  you have been succesfull in obtaining @resource/relics.webp@ and/ or @resource/sacred_sites.png@. HRE has a nice little advantage of not needing any @resource/resource_gold.png@@unit_worker/villager.png@ to reach @age/age_4.png@. notes: Before vils drop wood, after IO is created, make a mill @building_economy/mill.png@ (preferably next to berries) , dont shift click the vils!
IO@unit_chinese/imperial-official.png@ supervises the mill while its being built so that the vils drop off wood immediately after they are done building and you get extra 20% from that wood.
Next vil @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ builds a village @building_chinese/village.png@ next to the mill. Then gathers food @resource/resource_food.png@.
Next vil @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ goes to straggler wood @resource/resource_wood.png@, gathers only 3 and force drops off. Then he builds gold mine @building_economy/mining-camp.png@.
Next 2 vils @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ go to gold @resource/resource_gold.png@, you want 3 vils mining gold total.
Next 3 vils @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ go to food @resource/resource_food.png@. Remember to gather tax from mill once it gets to 40, then keep supervising mill.

Either build Barbican @landmark_chinese/barbican-of-the-sun.webp@ with 2 vils or Imp. Academy @landmark_chinese/imperial-academy.png@ with 3 vils. Use food vils. They return to food @resource/resource_food.png@ once they are done.
Once you have 10 vils on food, next 2 vils @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ go to straggler wood@resource/resource_wood.png@.

Build the second feudal landmark (@landmark_chinese/imperial-academy.webp@or@landmark_chinese/barbican-of-the-sun.png@) with 4 vils from food. They go to wood @resource/resource_wood.png@ once they are done. You should leave 6 vils on food for now.
Once you have 160 gold @resource/resource_gold.webp@ take all vils from gold to straggler wood @resource/resource_wood.png@. Research wheelbarrow @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.png@
Build a lumber camp @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ and supervise it with your IO @unit_chinese/imperial-official.png@.

Use 4 wood vils to build eitther barracks @building_military/barracks.png@ or archery range @building_military/archery-range.png@, they go mine stone @resource/resource_stone.png@ after they are done, supervise the stone mine too with the second IO@unit_chinese/imperial-official.png@.
Remember to keep picking up tax constantly from all camps.

You can start making some small walls @building_defensive/palisade-wall.png@ with a single vil from wood @unit_worker/villager-china.png@ or a tower@building_defensive/outpost.png@ to protect resources/gain vision. Dont spend too much wood  or second TC is gonna get delayed.
Build the second TC @building_economy/town-center.webp@ , use vils from stone.
Make the fourth IO @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@. Three supervise each resource and one gathers tax. Reorganize your economy according to your game plan.

If you're going against an aggressive opponent : 15 vils on food@resource/resource_food.webp@, 15 on wood@resource/resource_wood.png@, 6 on gold@resource/resource_gold.png@, rally @resource/rally.png@both TCs to food@resource/resource_food.png@ and start producing a defensive army@unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@@unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.png@ with its upgrades @building_technology/blacksmith.png@. Gradually prepare a farm@building_chinese/granary.png@@building_economy/farm.png@ transition. Eventually, when you have around 40 on food, you can start rallying to gold instead and you will "naturally" age up@age/age_3.png@. If opponent ages up, attack them and age up yourself.

If youre going against a passive opponent: Just age up to castle. Assign 6 vils@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to gold@resource/resource_gold.png@ and move all but 6 vils from wood@resource/resource_wood.png@ to food@resource/resource_food.png@.
If your opponent wasnt agressive, advance to castle with the Clocktower @landmark_chinese/astronomical-clocktower.webp@, use 8 vils to build it.

At this point start rallying @resource/rally.webp@ to gold @resource/resource_gold.png@ until you have 15 vils @unit_worker/villager-china.png@ on it and research imperial examinations @technology_chinese/imperial-examination.png@ because you will need a lot for unit and blacksmith upgrades @building_technology/blacksmith.png@, monks@unit_religious/monk-3.png@ and units. Create a stronger army @unit_chinese/palace-guard-3.png@@unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.png@with some nest of bees @unit_chinese/nest-of-bees.png@and secure relics @building_religious/monastery.png@@resource/relics.png@ if you can.

Archers as a follow up can come faster if you want it to, but most importantly, Archers should always come before mercenaries. If you go Merc Camp first, you lose too much tempo. Always try to gather from berries before deer because the oil gives you a lot of extra power through Mercs.

2nd @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@ on home @resource/berrybush.webp@, where your @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ will be. Set it to increase research.

@age/age_2.webp@ with 3 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@,  @abilities/repair.webp@@landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@. All others to @resource/resource_wood.webp@, leave 4 on @resource/resource_food.webp@. @resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
Remember to add @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@ whenever you have 120 @resource/resource_stone.webp@. Prio @resource/berrybush.webp@ but get as many res as you can, but be safe.
Keep @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@. 8 to sustain units, 10 so you can slowly add @building_economy/farm.webp@, 9 is a decent middle ground.

All 4 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@and all 3@abilities/repair.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@ for 7 total. @resource/rally.webp@@resource/berrybush.webp@ for mercs.
Get @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@  @building_byzantines/mercenary-house-2.webp@ and another military building depending on what you scout on the enemy ASAP.

Remember the others @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@@technology_economy/horticulture.webp@@technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@, and important @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ techs.
Make some units, harass. Figure out if the enemy wants to continue fighting or not. If not, aim for @age/age_3.webp@.

Rebalance eco to prep for @age/age_3.webp@. Pull ~5 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to extra @resource/berrybush.webp@ with @building_defensive/outpost.webp@. Pull the @resource/resource_stone.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@. Get @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@and @resource/resource_gold.webp@ or @resource/rally.webp@ to them.
Rebalance eco. Get 9-10 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ so you can slowly add @building_economy/farm.webp@.
At this point you can all in. Don't forget @resource/relics.webp@. Keep producing and putting on pressure.

description:
Play when against aggro civs. If against passive, play the 2 TC one. Some pointers:
1. Remember to build cisterns ASAP when you get 120 stone.
2. Important to scout enemy and produce the counters in Feudal.
    a. If enemy is pro scouts, get spears + longbow and deny deer packs.
    b. If enemy is archers, get horsemen + longbow.
3. Expend all Gaia food before adding farms, especially berries.

name: Byzantines 2TC 4:30
author: Acanthophis

notes: Once you got the 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ move to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ (or @resource/resource_stone.webp@ if it is closer)
2x @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ (in the video I move the vills at 2:15, so you can get your 2TC at 4:20)

get 3 from @resource/resource_food.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ 1 to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ keep @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to hit 4 then @resource/rally.webp@ on ::str. If you did @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ at 02:00 then @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@. You just need 4 on @resource/resource_stone.webp@. You keep 7 on food after @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ for 1-2 dropoff so that 3 on @resource/resource_food.webp@ can sustain @unit_worker/villager.webp@ production.

you take 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ to build 1 @building_economy/house.webp@.  Once the house is done, you take him + 1 from @resource/resource_stone.webp@ so you build the @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ with 3 now. You only need 268 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ by the @age/age_2.webp@ because the @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ will give you 32. Keep @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ until @age/age_2.webp@

Congratulations! You reached @age/age_2.webp@ with 400 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and 300 @resource/resource_stone.webp@. Start building your second @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ with the 10x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from the @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@. I keep my @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@ and add the 3 from @resource/sheep.webp@ to them. The 3 on stone remain there to complere my @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@ Network as fast as possible. @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@ with main @building_economy/town-center.webp@. I like to have about 12-14 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ so I can go to @building_byzantines/mercenary-house-2.webp@ and other militray buildings right away, have wood for @building_byzantines/olive-grove-1.webp@ and @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ in case I want to defend @resource/resource_gold.webp@ / @resource/resource_stone.webp@. You don't even need to go out for another @resource/berrybush.webp@.

(In the video you will see that I misclicked and garrisoned 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ at the last dropoff before the second @building_economy/town-center.webp@ placement, it is irrelevant to the timing of the @building_economy/town-center.webp@ placement as he was working before that on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@.)

Four starting villagers gather one full load of Gold each, move directly to Stone, build a Forge, and then mine Stone. Two additional villagers join Stone

Daimyo Manor completed around 2:20
Feudal age-up started around 3:08
Feudal Age reached around 3:52
Second ::TC started around 3:58

author: Jockxtar

notes: Put 1 @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside @building_military/archery-range.webp@ once you start floating @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and mass a big ball of @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@. Make enough @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to defend the @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ and spend the rest of the @resource/resource_food.webp@ on @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@

If you want to all-in, change @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@ upgrade order to: @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ -> @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@ -> @technology_military/siege-engineering.webp@ -> @technology_military/bloomery.webp@ -> @technology_military/fitted-leatherwork.webp@
So you can start making @unit_siege/battering-ram.webp@ early.
Make only units if necessary to defend.
Build @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ with @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ while @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@ raid enemy economy.
Move 3 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ if you are not making @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@

Move @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ to @resource/sacred_sites.webp@ a few seconds before @technology_delhi/sanctity.webp@ finishes. If a @resource/sacred_sites.webp@ is not safe, scort the @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ with your army.
Never risk loosing @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@, they are very expensive without @landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@
After @technology_delhi/sanctity.webp@ is researched, spend @resource/resource_gold.webp@ on @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ (at least 5 before @age/age_3.webp@)

If you are forced to stay in @age/age_2.webp@ for too long, train additional @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ so you don't float over 600 @resource/resource_gold.webp@, or trade it for @resource/resource_food.webp@ at a @building_economy/market.webp@ for a faster @age/age_3.webp@.
Build small @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ around @resource/relics.webp@ to deny them from opponents playing for Fast Castle.
@landmark_delhi/house-of-learning.webp@: Better in most situations. Good for scaling both the army and the economy.

@landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.webp@: Good in match-ups where you want to play defensive and boom your economy as soon as possible, extending @age/age_3.webp@ until you can safely go to @age/age_4.webp@
Train additional @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@. At least 5 before @age/age_3.webp@, but never going below 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@, you will need it for units.
Put 1 @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside @building_military/stable.webp@ right before landmark is completed
If you have enough economy, make @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ and @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@ depending on the enemy army.

Research @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ and @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@ @age/age_3.webp@ upgrade with the second @building_military/barracks.webp@/@building_military/archery-range.webp@/@building_military/stable.webp@
Depending on how defensive the enemies are playing:
@abilities/repair.webp@@building_defensive/keep.webp@ in your base to defend against raids.
@abilities/repair.webp@@building_defensive/keep.webp@ to protect key resources in the middle of the map.
*@landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.webp@: Build @building_defensive/stone-wall.webp@ with infantry to protect your base.
3 @building_defensive/keep.webp@ is a good amount to stop gathering @resource/resource_stone.webp@.
<- Ideal economy should look like this
After technologies are done, garrison @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside military buildings or move them out to heal units after fights.
Delay @building_economy/farm.webp@ transition as much as possible, gather from @resource/berrybush.webp@ and @resource/deer.webp@ instead.

@landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.webp@: for faster tempo (faster late game upgrades) and better food economy. Allows you to liberate population space for a bigger army while keeping high production of @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@ and @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@

@landmark_delhi/palace-of-the-sultan.webp@: produces @unit_delhi/sultans-elite-tower-elephant-4.webp@, which are very strong, but not quite as strong as @unit_infantry/handcannoneer-4.webp@ with @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@
Make @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ up to 20, but don't build more than 3 @building_religious/mosque.webp@, the other will garrison on @landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.webp@.
Research all upgrades, both economic and military, even the ones from @building_military/dock.webp@ if the map has water.

After unit upgrades, economic technologies, @technology_military/elite-army-tactics.webp@ and @technology_military/biology.webp@ are completed: Garrison a few @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside military buildings.
With this army composition, @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ healing is not as important as if we were playing with elephants.
Build @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@/@building_defensive/stone-wall.webp@ with your units as you push into the opponent's side of the map to protect reinforcements and control resources.
<- Ideal economy should look like this

Use @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@/@unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ to build @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ around your base and to escort @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ while they capture @resource/sacred_sites.webp@
Move @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ to capture @resource/sacred_sites.webp@ a few seconds before @technology_delhi/sanctity.webp@ finishes.

Don't fight too hard for @resource/sacred_sites.webp@. Use them as a distraction, forcing the enemies to move out of their base and creating more opportunitites to raid. Obviously the extra @resource/resource_gold.webp@ is nice, but don't take bad fights to defend them.

If you are forced to stay in @age/age_2.webp@ for longer and make units, train additional @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ so you don't float over 600 @resource/resource_gold.webp@, or trade it for @resource/resource_food.webp@ at a @building_economy/market.webp@ for a faster @age/age_3.webp@
Train additional @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ (but never going below 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@, you will need it for units)
A few seconds before @age/age_3.webp@ move @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ near @resource/relics.webp@ to grab them as soon as you age up.
If you are scared of @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@ diving your base, make 1 @unit_delhi/war-elephant.webp@ first to defend alongside @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@

Make 4 @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ to steal @resource/deer.webp@ from the opponent's side of the map once @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@ finishes, securing @resource/resource_food.webp@ and delaying the farm transition.

After technologies are done, garrison @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside military buildings or move them out to heal units after fights.
Delay @building_economy/farm.webp@ transition as much as possible, gather from @resource/berrybush.webp@ and @resource/deer.webp@ instead.

@landmark_delhi/palace-of-the-sultan.webp@: good long-term value. @unit_delhi/sultans-elite-tower-elephant-4.webp@ are the strongest unit in the game and a push with 5 or more of them with a full army can be devastating.

@landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.webp@: for faster tempo (faster late game upgrades) and better food economy. Allows you to liberate population space for a bigger army while keeping high production of @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@ and @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@
Make @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ up to 20, but don't build more than 3 @building_religious/mosque.webp@.
After upgrades are completed move @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ with the army to heal during fights.

description:
Inspired by Beasty's early aggro into 2TC french, I wanted to make something that could skip the archery range, and get a faster 2nd TC. By going Jeanne as archery, she can support your knights and harass while you get an earlier 2nd TC, + all the benefits of JD.

You have JD as a support unit, if she dies, most likely dont buy her back, (until late game when gold is flowing), Play normal french with the OP Jeanne to support. 

I have been playing this at the Plat/Diamond level and having alot of fun, it is incredibly Micro intensive, but you play games and feel the win or loss was in how you played it.

name: English | Fast Castle with farms
author: Jockxtar

notes: @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@: Ideal to match fast @age/age_3.webp@ strategies. The @unit_english/king-2.webp@ comes for free and can delay a bit the enemy timing. Later on, the healing aura is very strong on @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ to have constant pressure.
@landmark_english/council-hall.webp@: Better for aggressive strategies. This strategy relies heavily on @unit_english/king-2.webp@ healing instead.

Gradually @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/farm.webp@. One with 2 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@, the other 2 with @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ until you have 8 around the @building_economy/mill.webp@.
@landmark_english/kings-palace.webp@: This landmark will help you scale your economy in the mid game. Best option unless you are afraid of a potential all-in from your opponent.
@landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@: The safest choice. Ideal to protect your @building_economy/farm.webp@ even better.
Queue @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ ASAP and use them to raid and distract the opponent. If you have the @unit_english/king-2.webp@ alive, move them together.
@abilities/repair.webp@@building_military/archery-range.webp@ and @building_military/barracks.webp@ to defend your base while your cavalry raids.
Eventually, you can join forces and go for a strong push on the enemy base.
Spend excess @resource/resource_gold.webp@ on upgrades, don't build second @building_military/stable.webp@
If you are loosing @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@, you need to play more carefully with them.
Keep adding @building_economy/farm.webp@ gradually until you have 5 full packs (total of 40)
Then @resource/rally.webp@ -> @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and keep adding @building_economy/farm.webp@ and production buildings.

The goal during @age/age_3.webp@ is to apply a lot of pressure with our superior @resource/resource_food.webp@ economy to damage our opponent and slow down their scaling while we get ready to go @age/age_4.webp@.
We can also add @unit_siege/trebuchet.webp@ to finish our opponent if we have a big lead, but going @age/age_4.webp@ is always ideal with @civilization_flag/eng.webp@.

@landmark_english/wynguard-palace.webp@: If you have secured map control in @age/age_3.webp@ and have access to @resource/resource_gold.webp@, this landmark will allow you to snowball the game and to compete with the strongest late game civilizations toe to toe.

@landmark_english/berkshire-palace.webp@: If things are tied, this landmark is super good at securing map control and key resources. Also, if you are behind and at risk of getting all-in by your opponent, this landmark will save you.
<- Ideal economy balance should look like this:

Push forward slowly while building @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ and @building_defensive/keep.webp@, slowly creeping closer and closer to the enemy base, so that you always benefit from the bonus attack speed.

After researching @technology_military/incendiary-arrows.webp@ and @technology_military/silk-bowstrings.webp@ at @building_technology/university.webp@, @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@/@unit_english/wynguard-ranger-4.webp@ counter siege units, even @unit_siege/mangonel-3.webp@, and their high base damage makes them quite competent against cavalry and armored units as well.

description:
Fast Castle build order with farms in Dark Age.
This gives you the ability to not run out of food after reaching Castle Age while still getting an early age up.

name: English | Team games Longbow rush
author: Jockxtar

notes: Wait with them in your base until you have 2 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and 3 @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@

Once you have 2 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and 3 @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@, move out of your base towards enemy @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to deny either @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ production or fast @age/age_3.webp@

Those units are enough to catch isolated @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ and force them to run away, that way the cavalry player will have to completely ignore you or to commit with all of their units, likely loosing one or two (depending on micro) in the process.
This will heavily delay the raids, building a lot of time for you and your team to stablish proper defenses. It's ok to loose these units as long as they can make time.
If you are playing with an ally making @age/age_2.webp@@unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ and want to commit to an all-in, keep making @unit_english/longbowman-2.webp@ and @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@.

@abilities/repair.webp@@building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and move 4 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ once you start floating @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Keep making @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ at home to defend.
@abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/house.webp@ as needed and slowly move @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @building_economy/farm.webp@

Once you finish the first pack of @building_economy/farm.webp@, build @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and gradually add more @building_economy/farm.webp@, but this time with @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@
16 @building_economy/farm.webp@ are more than enough to make units and quickly get to @age/age_3.webp@

@landmark_english/kings-palace.webp@: Allows you to catch up in economy to the opponents who started with a second @building_economy/town-center.webp@. Since you have a decent amount of @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ defending, you should not need the inmediate protection of the other landmark.

@landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@: Since we already have @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to defend and @landmark_english/council-hall.webp@ to quickly produce units, most of this landmark's value is lost in this build order.

You need at least 15 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ by the time you reach @age/age_3.webp@ to get upgrades. Move @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ if necessary.

Upgrade @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, produce @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@& @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@, and research economic upgrades (@technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@, @technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@, @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@, @technology_economy/horticulture.webp@)
Add another @building_military/barracks.webp@ and then @abilities/repair.webp@ more @building_economy/farm.webp@, @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ and @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@

Once you have a strong army to push and some @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ upgrades, mine @resource/resource_stone.webp@ with 5 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ and @abilities/repair.webp@@building_defensive/outpost.webp@ wherever you expect you will be fighting in the future (i.e. next to large @resource/resource_gold.webp@, in front of your allies' bases, etc.).

Tip : commencer par les moutons loin du TC protège des rushs — les B proches restent accessibles plus tard.
Les 2 premiers @unit_worker/villager.webp@ sortant du @building_economy/town-center.webp@ vont directement sur @resource/resource_gold.webp@.

Construire l'@landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@ — le placer dans la zone d'influence (carré) de la citerne pour accélérer la production militaire.
Construire un @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ avancé et une @building_economy/house.webp@ supplémentaire.
⚠️ Ne pas supprimer les arbres autour — vous avez besoin de 3 arbres pour ce build.
Lancer immédiatement le contrat des @unit_byzantines/keshik-2.webp@ Keshigs (coûte 400 huile d'olive — vous en avez 800 : 2 packs possibles).
Lancer le 2ème pack de @unit_byzantines/keshik-2.webp@ Keshigs (2x400 huile d'olive depuis les 6 B = 800 au total).
Placer la citerne d'avance sur un point d'intérêt : B + @resource/resource_gold.webp@ si possible.
Envoyer un @unit_worker/villager.webp@ construire un aqueduc pour relier les deux citernes.
Dès l'âge 3 : lancer le contrat vétéran sur les @unit_byzantines/keshik-2.webp@ Keshigs.
Si le moulin est sous la citerne, activer Dialectique.
Activer le Glops automatique sur la citerne : +25 HP/s pendant 6s sur les unités à faible vie.
Utiliser Triomphe de l'Hippodrome lors des grands combats (+dégâts, +vitesse, régénération).

Rechercher @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ Résistance aux flèches rang 1 puis @technology_byzantines/teardrop-shields-3.webp@ +1 armure corps à corps ET distance sur @unit_byzantines/cataphract-3.webp@.
Ajouter des @building_military/stable.webp@ écuries pour produire plus de @unit_byzantines/cataphract-3.webp@ Cataphractes.
Combo idéal en multi : @unit_byzantines/cataphract-3.webp@ Cataphractes + @unit_byzantines/keshik-2.webp@ Keshigs (allié archer recommandé).
Réutiliser Triomphe après chaque combat — les points d'approvisionnement (kills) augmentent sa durée.

Best conditions: This build works best on maps with safe starting gold (close to your TC) or if you are in a safe team position (pocket).

Reallocate your economy to the optimal setup: 13 on @resource/resource_food.webp@, 10 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@, and the rest (~10) to @resource/resource_wood.webp@. description:
This build order covers the innovative HRE strategy popularized by German pro player Gullyd3ck3l. This guide is based on the comprehensive video analysis by VortiX.
Unlike the traditional HRE meta (Meinwerk into Pro Scouts or naked Fast Castle), this build relies on an Aachen Chapel opening with 6 very fast farms built tightly around it.
Key Features:
- Dark Age Barracks: Early Spearmen production to secure map control or pressure the enemy's gold.
- Feudal Defense: Upgrading Hardened Spearmen and mixing in Men-at-Arms to comfortably hold any Feudal pressure without delaying Castle Age too much.
- Eco Security: Zero reliance on out-of-map resources (Deers/Berries). You transition safely to Castle Age with a booming, fully-protected farm transition right under your Town Center and Chapel influence.

name: Knights Templar | Dark Age tower rush
author: Jockxtar

notes: Send @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ to opponent base to locate @resource/resource_gold.webp@/@resource/resource_stone.webp@/@resource/berrybush.webp@
@building_military/barracks.webp@ make @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@. Unless enemy makes defensive units, make only 3
When 2nd @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ is out, send 1 @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to build @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ at enemy base
- On @resource/resource_gold.webp@: Against @age/age_2.webp@@unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ civs and fast @age/age_3.webp@ civs
- On @resource/berrybush.webp@: Against civs with bonuses on @resource/berrybush.webp@ gathering
You should have enough @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for the outpost now.
If the enemy is making their own units to defend, make more @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@

Move 6 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ -> @resource/resource_gold.webp@ once you have 200 @resource/resource_food.webp@ in the bank and are no longer making @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@

@civilization_flag/ant.webp@: @unit_templar/serjeant_age_2.webp@ are great in @age/age_2.webp@ against @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@, making this the best option in those matchups (@civilization_flag/fre.webp@, @civilization_flag/jda.webp@, @civilization_flag/rus.webp@, @civilization_flag/mon.webp@, @civilization_flag/goh.webp@), but they are quite expensive and weak against @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@, so you shouldn't commit to a @age/age_2.webp@ all-in. Going @age/age_3.webp@ to get @unit_templar/heavy_spearman_age_3.webp@ and @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ would be the best strategy.

@civilization_flag/hos.webp@: @unit_templar/hospitaller_knight_age_2.webp@ are decently tanky and, with good micro, they can save units from dying even while diving the enemy static defenses. Good for all-ins when supporting @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ + @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ armies.

@civilization_flag/kof.webp@: Heavy cavalry in @age/age_2.webp@ are super strong and the bonus unit production speed allows you to outproduce most civilizations in the game. Additionally, you will force the enemy to make @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, which you will counter with @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@. Perfect for @age/age_2.webp@ all-ins unless your opponent can make heavy cavalry (@civilization_flag/fre.webp@, @civilization_flag/jda.webp@, @civilization_flag/rus.webp@, @civilization_flag/mon.webp@, @civilization_flag/goh.webp@)
Upon aging up you can do whatever you want.
- 2 @building_economy/town-center.webp@: Send @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and @resource/resource_stone.webp@ during age up
- Fast @age/age_3.webp@: Macro towards @resource/resource_food.webp@ and @resource/resource_gold.webp@ while the enemy is distracted trying to take down the @building_defensive/outpost.webp@

description:
Dark Age tower rush with spearmen to block gold, stone or berries at enemy base.

DO NOT do this build order against HRE, China, Zhu Xi, English, House of Lancaster, Mongol or Rus; they can either make a lot of units very early in the game, have villagers with ranged attacks or both.

My other Knights Templar build orders:
- Feudal all-in: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/3zDTNY0CFvLUA8dZ0UnX
- 2TC: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/4eHSzSzuResmbfKsdVCV

name: Knights Templar | Feudal all-in
author: Jockxtar

notes: 2 to closest @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@; they will go gather @resource/sheep.webp@ after they fully chop it
2 to closest @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@; they will go gather @resource/resource_gold.webp@ after they fully chop it

@civilization_flag/kof.webp@: The best option for this strategy. Heavy cavalry in @age/age_2.webp@ are super strong and the bonus unit production speed allows you to outproduce most civilizations in the game. Additionally, you will force the enemy to make @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, which you will counter with @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@.

@unit_templar/chevalier_confrere_age_2.webp@ are discounted feudal knights, decent for early raids and harassing opponents, but they are worse in direct combats. Still, once you group a large amount they can overwhelm enemy archers.
@civilization_flag/hos.webp@: vs @civilization_flag/abb.webp@ or @civilization_flag/ayy.webp@ (they can very easily counter cavalry).

@unit_templar/hospitaller_knight_age_2.webp@ are decently tanky in @age/age_2.webp@ and, with good micro, you can save units from dying during the early game, even while diving the enemy static defenses. They don't scale very well into @age/age_3.webp@, but they become considerably tanky in @age/age_4.webp@.

@civilization_flag/ant.webp@: Is better for tempo/scaling strategies. Still, they are the best option vs @civilization_flag/fre.webp@ and @civilization_flag/jda.webp@, since they have @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@ which destroy @unit_templar/chevalier_confrere_age_2.webp@ and @unit_templar/hospitaller_knight_age_2.webp@.

@unit_templar/serjeant_age_2.webp@ are a great unit to mass in Feudal Age, but way too expensive and are soft-countered by @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ and static defenses. This makes all-ins with this unit very difficult.

The @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ should be close to finishing chopping their respective tree and then moving 2 to @resource/sheep.webp@ and 2 to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Pay attention so that they don't go chop more trees.

Having 4 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ will secure enough income to produce @unit_templar/chevalier_confrere_age_2.webp@ without relying on pilgrims, which can be denied easily by our opponent.

Produce @unit_templar/chevalier_confrere_age_2.webp@ until you have 5 and use them to raid. Make sure they take as little damage as possible, forcing idle time is good enough and we need a large amount of them for the all-in.

You can research @technology_military/bloomery.webp@ first for @unit_worker/villager.webp@ kill breakpoint on @unit_templar/chevalier_confrere_age_2.webp@ (charge + 3 normal attacks instead of 4), but this will delay your all-in timing. Do it only if you are confident on your micro or if you want to punish enemy @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/deer.webp@.
One pilgrim generates 130 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ per minute, which coincides perfectly with @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ upgrades.
If you ever lack @resource/resource_food.webp@ to produce units, prioritize @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@
If you build @building_military/barracks.webp@, move 4 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ -> @resource/resource_food.webp@; otherwise move only 2.
Either way, pause @unit_templar/chevalier_confrere_age_2.webp@ production until you have enough @resource/resource_food.webp@
Now should be a good time to resume @unit_templar/chevalier_confrere_age_2.webp@ production.

Move @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/deer.webp@ or @resource/boar.webp@ if you have map control. This will spike your unit production significantly, therefore you should build more military buildings to spend the resources.
Once you have over 10 @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@, if you lack @resource/resource_food.webp@ but have too much @resource/resource_wood.webp@, make @unit_siege/battering-ram.webp@
2 @unit_siege/battering-ram.webp@ is enough to destroy secondary @building_economy/town-center.webp@, but don't move for the main @building_economy/town-center.webp@ until you have at least 4.

If you float too much @resource/resource_gold.webp@, you can build @building_economy/market.webp@ to buy other resources or another @building_military/stable.webp@ for more @unit_templar/chevalier_confrere_age_2.webp@.
If the game is not finished after a while and you want to change your strategy, age up to @age/age_3.webp@ to upgrade your army and deal the final blow.

@civilization_flag/ang.webp@: @unit_templar/heavy_spearman_age_3.png@ are amazing against @age/age_2.png@ armies that rely on cavalry. Going for these will allow you to close up the game in early @age/age_3.png@ against civilizations like @civilization_flag/fre.png@, @civilization_flag/jda.png@ and @civilization_flag/rus.png@, since their @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ will become useless and they will have no way to protect their @unit_cavalry/knight-2.png@.

@civilization_flag/gen.png@: @unit_templar/genoese_crossbowman_age_3.png@ are very strong against pretty much any unit, but are specially strong against melee infantry (most noticeably, @unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@). Their biggest counter are @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.png@ and @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@, but both can be dealt with our @age/age_2.png@ unique unit (@unit_templar/chevalier_confrere_age_2.png@, @unit_templar/hospitaller_knight_age_2.png@ or @unit_templar/serjeant_age_2.png@).

@civilization_flag/koc.png@: @unit_templar/genitour_age_3.png@ are ultra specific counter units. Good choice against @civilization_flag/ayy.png@@civilization_flag/abb.png@@civilization_flag/rus.png@@civilization_flag/mon.png@ if they are doing mounted cavalry units, but since we have been playing aggressive all this time, we should not wait to see what our opponent does after aging up, we want to have the upper hand by going @age/age_3.png@ first.

description:
As basic as possible (it looks scarier than it is!) Golden Horde build order for new players. Video below!

The goal is to be aggressive in the Feudal Age with Torguud, Archer & Spear/Kharash while slowly going to the Castle Age. This can be played on any land map against any* civilisation allowing you to get a foothold in any game and then diverge from there. Also works in team games!

Once you get Castle, you can look to end the game early with the help of Muscovy Yasak +2 ranged armour on your Torguud, MAA, and Rus Tributes, or you can save stone and later go for Barracks Reinforcements which is a huge power-spike where the Golden Horde really becomes a horde.

*Against feudal knight civs like French, you will want to alter this build and go Spearmen + Torguud in Feudal instead of massing Archers, even adding in Keshik if they mass their own Archers. Check out Pt2 of the below video for more info.

description:
Very basic, no-frills HRE build order for new players. Video below!

The goal is to build a balanced army (1-1-1) in the Feudal Age and attack. This can be played on any land map against any civilisation allowing you to get a foothold in any game and then diverge from there. Also works in team games!

There are 2 recommended choices once you complete the below build:
1. Go all-in with aggression! Add more production, make MAA, and get siege engineering from the Meinwerk so you can make rams with your infantry, and keep your food villagers working by adding farms or putting them on deer or berries.
2. Go Castle Age! Put a few more villagers to gold and age up with the Burgrave Palace. Once up, upgrade your existing units and overwhelm your opponent with super-upgraded MAA (+2 ranged armour, Two-Handed Weapons, Heavy Maces and +50% charge damage from the Burgrave itself!)

Once you're feeling comfortable with this build, look for more advanced and optimal build orders. HRE are very versatile and can be played pretty much every way, particularly having a very strong Fast Castle. Try Aachen Chapel and/or Regnitz Cathedral landmarks - they're a bit harder to use but very strong and a lot of fun. I recommend checking out a recent build order guide video from a pro player. Two good options are Beastyqt and Valdemar.

description:
As basic as possible Jin build order for new players making the most of the unique Jin cavalry. Video below!

The gameplan is Feudal aggression with Horsemen + Iron Pagoda + Mohe Tribesmen. The goal is to contain and raid your opponent, picking up villager kills when possible while taking deer/boar behind. It's a bit micro intensive for new players but very fun!

It's difficult to Feudal all-in as Jin so you'll often look to turn your advantage into a strong Castle Age timing, and perhaps even fast Imp (see below video!)

Good luck!

As basic as possible Sengoku build order for new players. Video below!

The goal is to build a Feudal Age army of Yari Cavalry + Yumi Ashigaru and attack. This can be played on any land map against any civilisation allowing you to get a foothold in any game and then diverge from there. Also works in team games!

There are 2 recommended choices once you complete the below build and attack:
1. Go all-in with aggression! Make more production for more units, get siege engineering from the blacksmith so you can make rams with your infantry, and keep your food villagers working by adding farms or putting them on deer, boar or berries.
2. Go Castle Age! Put a few more villagers to gold (or use the Matsuri market to buy/sell if you're floating resources) and age up with the Sake Brewery. Upgrade your Yumi and spam Mounted Samurai alongside your Daimyo to go kill your opponent with an incredibly strong unit composition!

Once you're feeling comfortable with this build, look for a more advanced and optimal build order. Note against feudal knight civs, you may want to alter this build and try spear + horsemen in Feudal instead. I recommend checking out a recent build order guide video from a pro player for the next step up. Two good options are Beastyqt and Valdemar.

notes: If there are @resource/deer.webp@ available and it's safe: @landmark_ottomans/twin-minaret-medrese-1.webp@ -> @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@

Keep your @unit_abbasid/imam.webp@ safe in your base until your @age/age_3.webp@ landmark is almost finished, then move them near @resource/relics.webp@ to immediately pick them up once it's completed.
@landmark_ottomans/mehmed-imperial-armory-2.webp@: Is the standard, good in all circumstances, build orders, matchups, maps, team compositions... Always a good choice.

@landmark_ottomans/istanbul-imperial-palace-2.webp@: Is only better in maps where trade is viable or when playing 2TC. That way you can play more greedy, get some free units with @technology_ottomans/janissary-company-1.webp@/@technology_ottomans/great-bombard-vizier.webp@ to defend with and still have some @age/vizier_point.webp@ for the more important upgrades like @technology_ottomans/military-campus-1.webp@, @technology_ottomans/advanced-academy-1.webp@, @technology_ottomans/siege-crews-1.webp@ and @technology_ottomans/trade-bags-1.webp@
Produce 1 @unit_ottomans/mehter-2.webp@ on @building_military/stable.webp@ and then @unit_ottomans/sipahi-2.webp@ or @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to defend

Produce either @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ or @unit_ottomans/sipahi-2.webp@ while aging up, but try to keep at least 240 @resource/resource_food.webp@ in reserve to immediately produce @age/age_3.webp@ units upon completing the landmark.
If you have any excess @resource/resource_food.webp@, produce @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@/@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ too.

If enemy has a lot of @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@, produce @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ and @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@ instead of @unit_ottomans/janissary-3.webp@ and @unit_ottomans/sipahi-2.webp@

Once you get 350 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, build 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ behind your base to protect future @building_economy/farm.webp@ placements. Ideally you want it near @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
<- Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Make a big army, fight a lot with your opponent before they can set up their economy and slowly grab @resource/relics.webp@ and capture @resource/sacred_sites.webp@
Our goal now is to slow down the game to get @age/vizier_point.webp@ until our economy is strong enough to go @age/age_4.webp@ comfortably.

*For the 4th @age/vizier_point.webp@, you can choose any upgrade you want, but it's too early to really benefit from @technology_ottomans/siege-crews-1.webp@, so leave that one for last. My recommendations:
- @technology_ottomans/janissary-company-1.webp@ can help you turn around a complicated situation or get an edge over the opponent's army and start a snowball effect.

- @technology_ottomans/pax-ottomana.webp@ on 1 @building_economy/town-center.webp@ is helpful, but not that great. On 2 @building_economy/town-center.webp@ though, it's a massive boost that allows you to reach optimal @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ count just as quickly as if you had started the game with the additional @building_economy/town-center.webp@.
@landmark_ottomans/sea-gate-castle-3.webp@: Only if you desperately need to protect your base from an incoming all-in OR if you are trading (which we are not doing in this guide).
If enemy is not making a lot of @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@, also upgrade @unit_ottomans/janissary-3.webp@ to elite and research @technology_ottomans/janissary-guns-4.webp@.
@technology_military/incendiary-arrows.webp@ only if you are making @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ instead of @unit_ottomans/janissary-3.webp@
<- Ideal economy balance should look like this:
Once you have a good bank of resources, you can delete @unit_worker/villager-ottomans.webp@ thanks to @building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@ free units.

Once you are close to max population, gather a lot of @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and do the @building_economy/farm.webp@ transition. You can keep reinforcing your army slowly thanks to @building_ottomans/military-school-1.webp@ and @landmark_ottomans/mehmed-imperial-armory-2.webp@, so the impact should be lower than for other civilizations.

notes: 3 aldeanos iniciales a @resource/resource_food.webp@ (ovejas). 2 aldeanos a @resource/resource_wood.webp@. El aldeano restante va a construir un @building_military/barracks.webp@ inmediato. Manda tu explorador rápido a buscar el recurso clave del rival.

El aldeano que termina el @building_military/barracks.webp@ construye una @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ pegada a las bayas (para optimizar la recolección futura) y luego va a @resource/resource_food.webp@. @resource/rally.webp@ a @resource/resource_food.webp@.
Produce exactamente 2 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ en cuanto termine el cuartel. Envíalos directamente a denegar el oro, las bayas o el recurso más expuesto de la base rival.

Mantén la recolección de @resource/resource_wood.webp@ de tus 2 aldeanos hasta juntar exactamente 75 de madera en total. Esto cubrirá el coste del campamento minero y el @building_japanese/forge-1.webp@ (Taguara).

Retira aldeanos de madera: deja solo 1 en @resource/resource_wood.webp@ y mueve los otros a @resource/resource_gold.webp@ para tener 3 en total. Desarrolla la mejora de Taguara en tu molino/bayas. Regresa el explorador a dejar ovejas en el @building_economy/town-center.webp@.

Cuando el único aldeano de madera termine de talar su árbol individual, construye la segunda @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ y muévelo a @resource/resource_food.webp@. Nos quedamos temporalmente con 0 en madera para priorizar el pase puro.
Al juntar 400 de comida y 200 de oro, inicia la transición: comienza a construir tu @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ con sólo 2 aldeanos extraídos de @resource/resource_food.webp@.

Llegada a @age/age_2.webp@. Reubica inmediatamente los 2 constructores del hito y los nuevos aldeanos al oro hasta tener un total estable de 10 en @resource/resource_gold.webp@. Si tu rival no ejerce presión masiva en Feudal, no piques madera ni hagas torres defensivas.

Al acumular 1200 de comida y 600 de oro, inicia la transición: clava el hito @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@ con 8 aldeanos. Mueve inmediatamente 5 aldeanos de comida a talar los árboles sueltos que rodean tu @building_economy/town-center.webp@ (sin construir maderero) para conseguir 150 de madera rápidamente.

Remacro tras clickear el hito: manda 5 de los constructores a @resource/resource_gold.webp@ (para un total de 12) y los otros 3 a @resource/resource_food.webp@ (total 13). Con los 150 de madera de los árboles del TC, usa 3 o 4 aldeanos para construir un @building_military/stable.webp@ inmediato. @resource/rally.webp@ general a @resource/resource_wood.webp@.

Llegada a @age/age_3.webp@. Transición completa. Introduce tu primer Yorishiro de la Puerta Flotante en el @building_military/stable.webp@ y arranca la producción constante de Samuráis Montados. Investiga inmediatamente la mejora @technology_japanese/tatara-1.webp@ (el +1 de daño de melé permite que tus caballeros maten aldeanos de solo dos golpes).

Construye una @building_military/archery-range.webp@ y deposita allí tu segundo Yorishiro para spamear arqueros de forma masiva. Desarrolla el Portaestandarte de la Arquería. Manda a tus monjes a asegurar las @resource/relics.webp@ sueltas por el mapa, investiga la Carretilla 2 y ahoga económicamente al rival combinando caballería pesada y rango.

notes: Try to also put it in range of @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and move @resource/sheep.webp@ inside the area.

@landmark_japanese/koka-township-1.webp@: If you have good micro. The active providing vision and the @unit_japanese/shinobi-2.webp@ can be extremely useful for the entire game if you use them correctly.

@landmark_sengoku/ryokan.webp@: Provides decent tempo advantage by saving up @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and building time of 6 @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@. The healing is very weak, but still better than nothing. Choose this if you are not confident on your ability to use the @landmark_japanese/koka-township-1.webp@ active skills.
(Even if you don't have the @resource/resource_wood.webp@ yet, move the @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ towards the @resource/resource_stone.webp@)
@building_military/barracks.webp@ make @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to defend the @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ against early cavalry.
Once you have a good amount of @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, keep an eye on enemy cavalry and try to preentively position them to protect your @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ and teammates economy.
If you lack @resource/resource_food.webp@ for @age/age_3.webp@, buy it at @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ or make @building_japanese/forge-1.webp@ upgrades.
@landmark_sengoku/sake_brewery.webp@: Grants a safe source of infinite @resource/resource_gold.webp@. The safest option and a massive economic boost.
Build it in a way that the mats spawn inside @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ aura.
@landmark_japanese/temple-of-equality-2.webp@: Allows picking up @resource/relics.webp@ very early and unlocks 2 very strong upgrades for @unit_sengoku/ikko_ikki.webp@ in @age/age_4.webp@.
Great long term value, but way worse in @age/age_3.webp@
@building_military/barracks.webp@ keep producing @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, but always leaving at least 190 @resource/resource_food.webp@ in reserve.

If you choose @landmark_sengoku/sake_brewery.webp@, move 5 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ and leave 5 of the builders gathering from @landmark_sengoku/sake_brewery.webp@ mats (the other 5 go to @resource/resource_food.webp@).
If you chose @landmark_japanese/temple-of-equality-2.webp@, move all 10 to @resource/resource_food.webp@.

If the first @building_sengoku/matsuri.webp@ is at the front of your base, build a second one for @building_economy/farm.webp@ at the back. Click 'Redirect Yatai' after it's completed to start buffing it with the @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@

Our @resource/resource_gold.webp@ income is enough to keep a constant production of @unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@ from 3 @building_military/stable.webp@, and since we will be adding @building_economy/farm.webp@, we will eventually have an excess of @resource/resource_food.webp@ that we can use to make @unit_sengoku/yari-2.webp@ to counter @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ or @unit_japanese/samurai-1.webp@ to counter @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@.
@landmark_sengoku/sword_hunt_statue.webp@: The increase to the @unit_sengoku/daimyo.webp@ attack speed aura makes @civilization_flag/sen.webp@ army insanely strong. By far the best option.
@landmark_japanese/castle-of-the-crow-4.webp@: Good in closed maps with key chokepoints. Overall quite weaker in team games.
Research @technology_sengoku/yatai_farm_gathering.webp@ and put 2 @unit_sengoku/yatai.webp@ in between your @building_economy/farm.webp@ (make sure they don't overlap).
Then you can consider researching elite upgrades for @unit_sengoku/yari-2.webp@, @unit_japanese/samurai-1.webp@ and @unit_sengoku/tanegashima_ashigaru-3.webp@
@unit_sengoku/tanegashima_ashigaru-3.webp@ are a good addition to the army since they are ranged units and benefit a lot from the bonus attack speed of @unit_sengoku/daimyo.webp@

@unit_sengoku/ikko_ikki.webp@ are also a great addition to the frontline, since they can heal the whole army every time they attack and can become quite tanky with upgrades, and they don't receive bonus damage from either @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ or @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@.

Last but not least, research @technology_japanese/oda-tactics-4.webp@ and @technology_military/serpentine-powder.webp@ as well as @technology_sengoku/samurai_yumi.webp@and @building_japanese/buddhist-temple-3.webp@ upgrades.

notes: Make 1 @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ and send it to scout for @resource/sheep.webp@ around @resource/resource_gold.webp@
When @building_economy/house.webp@ is about to finish, position second @unit_tughluq/worker_elephant.webp@ near @resource/resource_gold.webp@
@landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@: Is better for the late game but barely noticeable in the early game. Strong but risky.

@landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@: @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ on @age/age_2.webp@ are super strong, specially in the first few minutes of the game. This can help us defend until we recover the investment on the @building_economy/town-center.webp@. Much safer but worse scaling.
Leave the 4 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ on @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to later build and upgrade @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@

When you get 400 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, build @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ near your two @building_economy/town-center.webp@ with at least 2 empty tiles around it to build @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_economy/farm.webp@.

Select @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ as the governor for this @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@. The passive @resource/resource_food.webp@ will help us fund the extra @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ production and eventually go to @age/age_3.webp@.
Prioritize upgrading it rather than building new @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@.

If the opponent is playing aggressive and forces you to make units in @age/age_2.webp@, build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and research the upgrades, otherwise you will soon start floating @resource/resource_gold.webp@
@landmark_delhi/house-of-learning.webp@: Offers excellent upgrades for our core units (the elephants).

@landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.webp@: Since we are already playing very greedy with the second @building_economy/town-center.webp@, focusing on building and upgrading @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ is too greedy.
During age up make sure to build another @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ and assign @ability_tughluq/uch.webp@ as its governor for the discounts on upgrades.
Gradually build @building_economy/farm.webp@ and @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ to complete your economy.
Defend with an infantry army (@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ + @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@) and raid with @unit_tughluq/elephant_raider_age2.webp@
<- Ideal economy balance should look like this:
@building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ governors priority: @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ (tier 3) followed by @ability_tughluq/uch.webp@ (tier 1). Then pick based on the situation:
@ability_tughluq/ajmer.webp@ if under inmediate threat or to help secure an exposed @resource/resource_gold.webp@ vein.
@ability_tughluq/sehwan.webp@ if you manage to grab some @resource/relics.webp@.
@ability_tughluq/jalor.webp@ for a stronger cavalry army. Preferably leave it for later.
@ability_tughluq/multan.webp@ if you don't need/want the others. A bit unnecessary.

@landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.webp@: Can generate up to 300 @resource/resource_food.webp@ and 300 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ per minute, which is incredibly useful for the ideal @civilization_flag/tug.webp@ army that requires a lot of @resource/resource_gold.webp@.

@landmark_delhi/palace-of-the-sultan.webp@: The only tier 4 governor effects that are worth are @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@ for more resources and @ability_tughluq/jalor.webp@ for a bit of extra health on cavalry or @ability_tughluq/sehwan.webp@ for more healing on @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@.
Since we have already built and upgraded @ability_tughluq/bhakkar.webp@, we can discard that option.

@ability_tughluq/jalor.webp@ only grants 15 more health compared to the tier 3 effect, so it's not really worth it, although it can be useful for a timing attack right after aging up; since we are skipping the several minutes it takes to build and upgrade the @building_tughluq/tughluqabad_fort.webp@ (and the @resource/resource_stone.webp@ cost).

@ability_tughluq/sehwan.webp@ is ok, but nothing too crazy, and adding @unit_tughluq/healer_elephant.webp@ is very expensive for the stats they provide. It's good to have a few of them, but investing an entire landmark to buff them is not optimal.

description:
This is a build order based on the aggressive Feudal strategy showcased by pro player VortiX for Zhu Xi's Legacy.

This build revolves around a highly efficient early economy to rush the Jiangnan Tower landmark, transitioning into a massive food boom using Professional Scouts. By micro-managing your Imperial Officials for tax collection and supervising drop-off points, you set up an unstoppable Feudal Age engine.

⚔️ Core Game Plan:

Tight Dark Age: A perfectly timed opening to get the Jiangnan Tower down by leaving exactly 3 tiles of space for future production buildings.

The Pro Scouts Engine: Researching Professional Scouts immediately upon hitting Feudal Age to bring deer packs safely under your Town Center, generating massive, safe food income.

Aggressive Feudal Spam: Leveraging the incredible food and wood economy to drop multiple military buildings (Barracks & Archery Ranges) and relentlessly spam Zhuge Nu, Spearmen, and Horsemen to overwhelm your opponent and trigger the free units mechanic.

GLHF!

With full unit production, you will get a "pop" of units from @landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.webp@ at 9 mins in. This is important to cover your ageup or boost your aggro play
Now take 2 deer packs and decide on big all in play or castle age - I recommend being aggressive and aging behind, upgrading your units and going for an age 3 timing attack. Then take relics etc.

name: Japanese Fast Castle (MarineLord)
author: Aherys
reasoning: MarineLord's fast Castle: shrine gold and forge economy race to Castle Age where Japanese units spike hard. Punishes passive opponents; wall against early aggression.

notes: The two villager japanese on trees should be on town center close trees
Use first villager japanese to build barracks Then farmhouse 1 . rally point on food
Send immediatly 2 villager japanese from food to trees close of town center
When enough wood build mining camp and take 4 villager japanese of food
Villager japanese of wood go food All villager japanese Of food to berries . You can keep 1/2 on sheep . Build a farmhouse 1 next
Only One villager japanese to build kura storehouse 1 (two is against agressive)
3 villager japanese (always close trees of town center ) just for one trees Then rally to food
1 villager japanese (or more) to build outpost close to gold . Next villager japanese on gold
Once the trees cut down, don't forget the 3 villager japanese on food (Queue Action)
Use farm of kura storehouse 1 when avaible.
Take 7x villager japanese from food and build floating gate 2
On outpost fortify outpost arrow slits
Can spread villager japanese to berries deer takezaiku 2 When possible
Use 7x villager japanese of floating gate 2 to build stable
Send 3x villager japanese on wood and the 7x villager japanese on food . Hunt relics
Now 2:1 food gold for villager japanese
2x villager japanese From wood to stone (optional) if you need second fortify outpost
Shinto priest 3 on farmhouse 1 or mining camp then stable archery range
Rebalance villagers: 16 food / 8 wood / 10 gold / 2 stone.
Send all 6 starting villagers to sheep and keep making villagers nonstop.
Scout for sheep, gold, and your opponent.
Put 3 villagers on wood and build a Lumber Camp.
Build a House, and place a Farmhouse near your food so your farm economy starts strong.
Keep most villagers on food; transition onto Farms as the sheep run out.
Japanese farms are efficient — leaning on food keeps villagers producing.
Send 3 villagers to gold with a Mining Camp.
With about 400 food and 200 wood, age up to Feudal (Floating Gate for a safer boom).
Keep gathering through the age-up and decide your plan by scouting: economy, infantry, or mounted harass.
Build a Buddhist or Shinto Temple — its bonus supports whichever path you pick.
In Feudal, build a Barracks and start Samurai — they're durable and hit hard.
Add a Bannerman; its aura buffs nearby units in fights.
Take efficient fights around your Samurai's durability and the bannerman aura.
Keep adding Farms so your food never stalls while you produce army.
Pressure exposed villagers, but don't dive into mass ranged units — Samurai can be kited.
Pick up blacksmith upgrades and bank toward Castle Age.
In Castle Age, mix in Mounted Samurai and Handcannons, with a Mangonel for groups.
Use bannermen and Samurai durability to win the key fights and take the map.

name: Jeanne d'Arc Aggression (Valdemar)
author: Valdemar1902
reasoning: Valdemar's JD plan and the top-rated Jeanne build: level Jeanne on early skirmishes, then snowball with Royal Knights once she hits her champion levels. Her XP makes passivity a waste — this build keeps her fighting.

notes: Jeanne darc peasant 1 stays on sheep the whole Dark Age
Start 6 on sheep and look for the 1st deer pack around your base (there are two, one will be immediately outside tc vision range)
Once deer is found, take 5 villager and gather 50 wood and house
Build a mill on deer . Research survival techniques -> wheelbarrow immediately
Pull 4 villager from sheep to gold when mill is finished
Jeanne darc peasant 1 + 3 sheep villager build school of cavalry
Take rest of sheep villager and go to wood.
Queue specialized pick and royal knight 2 upon reaching feudal
Once 8 on wood rally then to gold until 8 and then back to food
Archery range & outpost if needed on gold and deer
Send 5 starting villagers to sheep. Send Jeanne straight to gold: build the Mining Camp, then the first House, then mine gold.
Keep the Town Center making villagers nonstop while Jeanne starts the gold income for your Feudal landmark.
Put the next villagers onto wood for houses and the School of Cavalry follow-up.
Jeanne can stay on gold until you have enough for the age-up, then help build or return to food.
Most new villagers go to food so the Feudal click is not delayed.
Use Jeanne safely: do not lose her scouting or trying to fight too early.
With about 400 food and 200 gold, age up with School of Cavalry for early Royal Knights.
Use 3 to 4 villagers on the landmark; keep enough on food that villager production never stops.
During the age-up, balance onto food and gold so the first Royal Knight starts immediately.
Add wood only for houses and a second production building later.
Queue Royal Knights from School of Cavalry as soon as Feudal finishes.
Keep Jeanne near safe fights or scouts so she gains experience without dying.
Add more villagers to gold so Knights keep producing.
Your first raids should hit exposed gold, wood, or berries; leave before Spearmen trap you.
Use 3 to 4 Knights to force idle time, not to fight under the enemy Town Center.
If they overbuild Spearmen, add Archers or go Castle behind the pressure.
Build a second Stable only if food and gold are both stable.
Keep Jeanne active but protected; leveling her is a bonus, not worth throwing the game.
Research key cavalry upgrades and decide: keep Feudal pressure if they are damaged, or bank for Castle if they stabilize.
Your beginner rule: Knights harass, villagers scale, Jeanne stays alive.

name: Jin Dynasty Standard (Swaggy)
author: Niki45nk
reasoning: Swaggy Professor's Jin standard — the highest-traction Jin build by far. One flexible opening that covers aggression and boom branches.

notes: Send all 3 mounted villager to mining camp gold Rally mounted villager to Reindeer deer
When you have 300 gold , 2 gold mounted villager go to sheep 1 gold mounted villager builds house , then also goes to sheep Use your scout to scout opponent's base

3 food mounted villager build great pasture Send 3 food mounted villager to gold Keep rally point mounted villager to food [If you are Tower Rushed] Immediately make a few mohe tribesman from great pasture to defend

Always train iron pagoda from great pasture ( mohe tribesman if you are spear rushed) Send 1 great pasture mounted villager to gold and 2 great pasture mounted villager to trees When you have 100 wood , 1 trees mounted villager builds grassland near great pasture , then goes to gold Use your iron pagoda to harass opponent's villager china or defend your own If opponent makes many spearman 1 , make a few mohe tribesman
When you have 8 food mounted villager , send them all to deer / boar and build mill Get mohe ancestry -> wheelbarrow at mill rally point mounted villager to gold
Send 5-8 gold mounted villager to build dragon pavilion at forward gold Send all other gold mounted villager to wood
Send all dragon pavilion mounted villager to gold Send emissary to nearby Trade Posts Build grassland near dragon pavilion Start getting Eco Upgrades Build blacksmith and monastery

notes: 6 on sheep with 1 repair house rally point to gold until 3
Now rally point to sheep until age up
Start age 2 lancaster castle with 3 gold vils back to repair manor Leave 3 on food and send others to 5 stone 1 wood rally point wood
Age 2 finishes at 4:05 All wood vils (7 vil) and age upper (3 vil) go build manor on wood then gather wood
When having 400 wood 300 stone start repair 2nd town center Stop gathering stone when having 100 extra(700 left on node) (for a 2nd manor)
2nd TC ready, Have at least 5-6 on food to produce from both TC
Can make 2nd manor on other resource Make production buildings and respond to enemy
