Важно: бонус добычи позолоченных жителей теперь 27%, а Inspired Warriors дают +10% урона и дополнительно вдохновляют соседние отряды в радиусе 0,5 клетки. Бисти в июле 2026 чаще играет Чжу Си; билд сверен по текущей мете, а не по его последним играм.
name: [1x1][SAFE][OTD][FC-IV] OTD: Castle в Imperial
author: Бисти, сверка Кодекс

notes: Цель билда: ранняя @age/age_3.webp@, контроль @resource/relics.webp@, затем четвертая эпоха только при стабильной экономике.
Пять жителей на @resource/sheep.webp@. @building_economy/town-center.webp@ никогда не простаивает.
Разведка: в 00:00 @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ разведчиком собрать @resource/sheep.webp@, найти безопасную охоту и проверить, не идет ли враг ломать быстрый переход.
Первый новый житель строит @building_economy/house.webp@ рядом с городским центром, затем идет на @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
Следующий новый житель тоже на @resource/resource_gold.webp@. @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ ищет @resource/sheep.webp@ и проверяет безопасную охоту.
Если рядом есть безопасные @resource/deer.webp@, отправь четыре-пять жителей, поставь @building_economy/mill.webp@ и изучи @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@.
Если @resource/deer.webp@ нет, играй через второй центр или более позднюю @age/age_3.webp@.
@resource/resource_food.webp@: в 00:55 заказать @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@ улучшение охоты только если жители реально собирают @resource/deer.webp@; без охоты это пустая трата.
Пропуск: в 00:55 @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ тачку до нажатия третьей эпохи обычно пропускай, чтобы не потерять тайминг.
Новых жителей держи на еде. Нужно быстро собрать 400 @resource/resource_food.webp@ и 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
Не покупай лишнее @resource/resource_wood.webp@: каждый лишний житель на дереве задерживает @age/age_3.webp@.
В варианте Бисти можно строить @landmark_hre/meinwerk-palace.webp@ одним жителем, чтобы больше людей добывало ресурсы.
Если нужен более простой и безопасный вариант, строй двумя-тремя жителями или выбирай @landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.webp@.
Поставь лесной лагерь только если нужен @building_economy/house.webp@, @building_economy/mill.webp@ или @building_defensive/outpost.webp@.
Основной разгон дают @resource/resource_food.webp@ и @resource/resource_gold.webp@, а не ранняя древесина.
Если охота или @resource/resource_gold.webp@ открыты, заранее ставь @building_defensive/outpost.webp@.
Против полного раннего давления делай войска и откладывай @age/age_3.webp@.
Во второй эпохе сразу разведай базу врага.
Много военных зданий у врага означает защитную игру; мало войск означает возможность быстрого перехода.

Анти-Чжу Си (разбор Pilsen 15.07.2026): феодальное давление переживают @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ со @technology_defensive/springald-emplacement.webp@ спрингалд-надстройками у точек добычи.
Распределение на @age/age_3.webp@: больше всего жителей на еде, затем @resource/resource_gold.webp@, минимум на дереве.
Не заказывай лишние отряды, если враг не идет в тебя.
Прокачка: в 04:50 @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ тачку брать только если разведка показала пассивного врага и @age/age_3.webp@ не задерживается.
Анти-Чжу Си: ранняя стрелковая броня @technology_military/fitted-leatherwork.webp@ обязательна — ты знаешь, что придет.
Анти-Чжу Си: изучи @technology_economy/textiles.webp@ текстиль — запас здоровья жителей спасает от набегов.
Контрольная точка: ты должен приближаться к 1200 @resource/resource_food.webp@ и 600 @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
Если @resource/resource_food.webp@ мало, добавь жителей на охоту или @resource/sheep.webp@. Если @resource/resource_gold.webp@ мало, добавь двух жителей на @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
Анти-Чжу Си: держи не более ~15 жителей на одной точке добычи — так один рейд не выбьет экономику.
Нажимай @age/age_3.webp@. Задержка до 6:40 приемлема, если пришлось защищаться.
@landmark_hre/burgrave-palace.webp@ по умолчанию. @landmark_hre/regnitz-cathedral.webp@ только при свободных реликвиях.
Пока строится @age/age_3.webp@, добавь @resource/resource_wood.webp@ на @building_religious/monastery.webp@, @building_economy/house.webp@ и военные постройки.
Не прекращай производство жителей ради более ранней армии.
Если выбран дворец @landmark_hre/burgrave-palace.webp@, сразу производи @unit_dragon/gilded-man-at-arms-2.webp@ и дави дальние ресурсы.
Если выбран @landmark_hre/regnitz-cathedral.webp@ собор, первые прелаты идут за реликвиями только под защитой армии.
@building_technology/blacksmith.webp@: в 08:10 заказать @technology_military/fitted-leatherwork.webp@ броню от стрел и @technology_military/bloomery.webp@ ближний урон, если давишь латниками.
Скорость: в 08:10 @technology_hre/marching-drills.webp@ походную подготовку брать для пешего давления; без пехоты отложить.
Поставь @building_religious/monastery.webp@, если прелаты не производятся из ориентира.
Состав: позолоченные латники впереди, @unit_dragon/gilded-crossbowman-3.webp@ против брони, @unit_dragon/gilded-archer-2.webp@ против @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ и копий.

Анти-Чжу Си: в Замке позолоченный ландскнехт @unit_dragon/gilded-landsknecht-3.webp@ бесполезен — ставь @building_military/stable.webp@ и делай @unit_dragon/gilded-knight-3.webp@ позолоченных @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@.
Раненых дорогих отрядов отводи назад и лечи @unit_hre/prelate.webp@.
У Ордена Дракона проигранный размен особенно болезнен, поэтому драки выбирай только с понятной целью.
Прокачка: в 09:50 заказать @technology_hre/inspired-warriors.webp@ вдохновленных воинов, если @unit_religious/monk-3.webp@ сопровождает армию.
Прокачка: в 09:50 @technology_hre/heavy-maces.webp@ тяжелые булавы и @technology_hre/two-handed-weapon.webp@ двуручное оружие брать только если основной состав - позолоченные латники.
Начинай @building_economy/farm.webp@ до окончания охоты. Провал @resource/resource_food.webp@ задержит четвертую эпоху на несколько минут.
Закрывай боковые проходы стенами и ставь @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ на дальнем золоте.
Решение о четвертой эпохе: жми только если у тебя есть @resource/relics.webp@, @resource/resource_food.webp@ и армия, которая не даст врагу снести базу.
Если враг давит, оставайся в @age/age_3.webp@ и производи войска.
Строй его восемью-двенадцатью жителями, но не снимай всю @resource/resource_food.webp@: армия должна продолжать выходить.
В четвертой эпохе дворец Швабии постоянно делает дешевых жителей, пока экономика не восстановится до большого числа.
Сначала элитные улучшения и экономика, затем ручницы и осада.
Прокачка: в 16:30 в четвертой эпохе заказать @technology_military/chemistry.webp@ химию для ручниц и осады, затем @technology_military/biology.webp@ биологию для @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@.
Прокачка: в 16:30 @technology_military/elite-army-tactics.webp@ элитную строевую подготовку брать, если много пешего ближнего боя.
Поздний состав: @unit_dragon/gilded-man-at-arms-2.webp@ впереди, @unit_dragon/gilded-crossbowman-3.webp@ и @unit_dragon/dragon-handcannoneer-4.webp@ позади, осада под защитой.
Если есть технология вдохновленных воинов, держи прелатов рядом с основной армией, но не отдавай их первыми.
Прокачка: в 18:30 @technology_military/incendiary-arrows.webp@ зажигательные стрелы брать только при большом дальнем войске если основа ручницы и @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@, сначала химия и броня.
Анти-Чжу Си: против гранатомётов — контр-осада @unit_siege/culverin-4.webp@ (имперская технология).

name: [1x1][SAFE][ZXL][2TC] Zhu Xi: Song и Mount Lu
author: Валдемар за 2026 год, русская сверка и проверка после майских изменений башни Цзяннань

notes: Начало похоже на другие порядки: жители и @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ на @resource/berrybush.webp@, @building_economy/mill.webp@, @resource/sheep.webp@ к @building_economy/mill.webp@ и постоянный надзор.
@resource/sheep.webp@ собираются у мельницы. @building_economy/town-center.webp@ не останавливает жителей.
Это не главный порядок по сверенной транскрипции.
Выбирай его только против пассивного развития, слабой ранней армии и безопасного @resource/resource_stone.webp@.
Разведка: 00:00 @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ собрать @resource/sheep.webp@, проверить @resource/resource_stone.webp@ и раннее военное здание.
Второй центр Чжу Си нельзя ставить вслепую.
@resource/resource_wood.webp@ и @resource/resource_gold.webp@ идут на второй центр, династию Сун и @age/age_3.webp@.
Первые восемь жителей на @resource/resource_food.webp@, затем четыре на @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
После начала перехода во @age/age_2.webp@ новые жители пойдут на @resource/resource_wood.webp@, потому что нужно @resource/resource_wood.webp@ для второго центра.
Один житель строит @landmark_zhuxi/meditation-gardens-1.webp@ на хорошей группе ресурсов.
Реворк садов: ставь ориентир на кластер @resource/resource_gold.webp@ + @resource/berrybush.webp@ + @resource/resource_stone.webp@.
Бонус сада растет на +5% каждые 30 секунд до +60%; деревья качаются только до +30%.
Через 330 секунд сад дает разовый выброс ресурсов — не переноси жителей раньше.

На @resource/deer.webp@ и @resource/sheep.webp@ аура сада не действует — считай только @resource/berrybush.webp@, @resource/resource_gold.webp@, @resource/resource_stone.webp@ и @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
@resource/berrybush.webp@ под садом собирай ПОСЛЕ окончания накачки, чтобы не потерять бонус.
@unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ собирает налог с мельницы и возвращается на надзор.
Если сады медитации рядом с камнем, второй центр получится заметно легче.
Начинай переход во @age/age_2.webp@ через сады медитации.
Сразу после начала перехода отправляй новых жителей на @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
Не ставь лишние здания до второго здания второй эпохи, иначе задержишь династию Сун.
Когда накоплено @resource/resource_gold.webp@ на второе здание второй эпохи, отправь жителей с @resource/resource_gold.webp@ на @resource/resource_stone.webp@.
Поставь @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ на @resource/resource_stone.webp@ и включи надзор чиновником.
@resource/resource_stone.webp@ под надзором позволяет поставить второй центр примерно на пятой минуте тридцатой секунде.
В активной игре дешевый переход через династию Тан часто важнее.
@landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.webp@ также полезна позже, если военные здания стоят в ее влиянии.
После династии Сун цель - дешевый второй центр.
Ставь второй @building_economy/town-center.webp@ примерно на пятой минуте тридцатой секунде.
Враг тоже ставит второй центр: свой можно ставить на охоте.
Есть риск атаки: ставь ближе и заранее готовь войско.
Новый центр сразу производит жителей без остановки.

Прокачка: в 05:30 @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ тачку брать только после запуска второго центра если враг давит, сначала @unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.webp@, @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ или @building_defensive/outpost.webp@.

@resource/resource_wood.webp@: в 05:30 @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ @resource/resource_wood.webp@ брать, если начинаешь @building_economy/farm.webp@ и династию Сун; пропустить при срочной обороне.
Добавь @building_chinese/granary.webp@ и первые @building_economy/farm.webp@, если внешняя @resource/resource_food.webp@ опасна.
Нужны два или три чиновника: один для @resource/resource_food.webp@, один для @resource/resource_wood.webp@, один для зернохранилища или налогов.
Не забывай строить @building_economy/house.webp@ заранее. При двух городских центрах нехватка места для населения приходит быстро.
Если враг тоже поставил второй центр, не увлекайся войском: обычно правильный ответ - быстрее выйти в @age/age_3.webp@.
Если враг идет в нападение, ставь @building_military/archery-range.webp@ или @building_military/barracks.webp@ и делай защитное войско.
Ориентир для защиты - около пятнадцати боевых единиц, если враг действительно давит.
Если враг тоже развивается, не делай лишнюю армию. Готовь @age/age_3.webp@.

Поставь @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ по краям. Два городских центра сильны только тогда, когда жители не умирают от набегов. Возьми @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@, @technology_economy/horticulture.webp@ и @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@.
Один центр можно направить на @resource/resource_food.webp@, другой на @resource/resource_wood.webp@; лишнее @resource/resource_wood.webp@ превращай в @building_economy/farm.webp@.

Прокачка: в 08:30 заказать @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ тачку, @technology_economy/horticulture.webp@ @resource/resource_food.webp@ и @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ @resource/resource_wood.webp@, если они еще не взяты.
Безопасность: в 08:30 @technology_economy/textiles.webp@ текстиль брать только если жители выходят за @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ или враг активно рейдит.
Начинай @age/age_3.webp@ через @landmark_zhuxi/mount-lu-academy-1.webp@ примерно на десятой минуте тридцатой секунде.
Академия горы Лу лучше подходит к двум городским центрам, потому что усиливает чиновников и налоговую экономику.
Баг сборки 16.3.11308: академия @landmark_zhuxi/mount-lu-academy-1.webp@ считается кипом и НЕ отдаёт налоги.
Налоги собирай с мельницы, лесопилки и зернохранилища — сбор с академии в план не закладывай.
Если враг готовит решающее нападение, задержи переход и сначала сделай войска.
Жадный второй центр не должен оставаться без защиты.

@building_technology/blacksmith.webp@: в 10:30 заказать @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@ дальний урон для @unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.webp@ и @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ против @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ первым можно взять @technology_military/fitted-leatherwork.webp@ броню от стрел.
Прокачка: в 10:30 после академии горы Лу заказать @technology_zhuxi/imperial-red-seals-3.webp@ красные печати чиновников, если экономика уже под контролем.
После третьей эпохи делай дворцовую стражу, @unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.webp@ и нужные ответы на состав врага.

Против тяжелой @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ добавляй @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ и @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@. Против @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ используй @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ и дворцовую стражу.
Продолжай @building_economy/farm.webp@ вокруг зернохранилища и сбор налогов.
Экономическое преимущество раскрывается после двенадцатой минуты.
Прокачка: в 12:00 @technology_zhuxi/dali-horses.webp@ далийских коней брать только если переходишь в @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@ и рейды; для пешей защиты отложи.
Не исследуй @technology_zhuxi/advanced-administration-4.webp@, пока не нанял всех чиновников: технология блокирует их найм.
+150 здоровья от @technology_zhuxi/advanced-administration-4.webp@ получают только уже существующие @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@.

二本地标 @landmark_french/school-of-cavalry.webp@ 提前 编号4 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@，385以上手动提交
点@technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@ & @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@，吃羊农手动提交，骑兵学校生产3 @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@去鹿区
1吃羊农，建造@building_military/archery-range.webp@，5农民TC穿越，去吃鹿。  持续生产@unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@保护背鹿
@building_military/archery-range.webp@建造好，转移3个吃羊农去采金，金农补@building_economy/house.webp@
持续金马和小弓，保护金区和背鹿，尽量不要断，持续生产@unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@@unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@
1农补 @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@，点@technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@@technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@，8分钟差不多6个小弓，3匹金马
开始8农吃猪肉，立塔，尽早开二金
兵回来，TC十几个吃肉农民去建造@landmark_french/guild-hall.webp@，TC补吃肉
@building_economy/town-center.webp@@resource/rally.webp@设置到@resource/sheep.webp@一直到食物农7个为止.
然后把@building_economy/town-center.webp@@resource/rally.webp@设置到 @resource/resource_wood.webp@一直到砍树农民3个为止，
如果@landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.webp@建造范围内没有能覆盖的金矿@resource/resource_gold.webp@
最先的150个@resource/resource_wood.webp@的用途:用1个@unit_worker/villager.png@@resource/resource_food.png@依次建造@building_economy/mill.png@,@resource/resource_wood.png@,@building_economy/house.png@,
准备充足的@resource/resource_food.webp@t发展到第四时代 @age/age_4.webp@
如果对手有进攻意图，或者@landmark_hre/aachen-chapel.webp@的位置比较危险,
8个@unit_worker/villager.webp@@resource/sheep.webp@去建造雷格尼茨大教堂@landmark_hre/regnitz-cathedral.webp@,生产 2个@unit_hre/prelate.webp@拿@resource/relics.webp@.
如果已被进攻，那么建造城主宫殿@landmark_hre/burgrave-palace.webp@
根据对手出兵情况灵活应对, 通常建造2个@building_military/stable.webp@生产4-12个 @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@
在有雷格尼茨大教堂@landmark_hre/regnitz-cathedral.webp@的情况
在第三时代有@landmark_hre/regnitz-cathedral.webp@并抢夺到几个圣物，
会有大量黄金资源支持大量出兵+点科技
1.所有农民点羊，TC定位到羊，侦察兵放出去
点选一个农民到矿场旁建造房子和矿场，再取消，TC定位到房子上
控制侦察兵找羊，一直到3农民采金子（补一个农民吃肉
703后，补一个农民吃肉达到803，之后的农民定位TC旁的散木
拉三个吃肉农民编队，达到二本要求后建立地标
50木头后拉种田农民下磨坊，下一个50木造伐木场
新出农民建造伐木场，提前点选散木农民shift到木区，TC定位到木区
又到50木，此时金也够150，点选磨坊科技小推车
又到50木，采金农民造房子，早晚后二本地标差不多完成
出两个长弓到敌人附近

造@unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@（约16秒/个），拉1木农种第三块田@building_economy/farm.webp@，TC补到10农采金@resource/resource_gold.webp@

拉1农种第四块田@building_economy/farm.webp@，多余资源升级科技@technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@@technology_japanese/tatara-1.webp@@technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@，目前3@unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@
将第二个@unit_japanese/shinto-priest-3.webp@的依代放进@building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@或@building_japanese/forge-1.webp@，目前7@unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@

notes: 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to build @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@@building_economy/house.webp@@building_byzantines/aqueduct-1.webp@+3 more @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@@building_byzantines/aqueduct-1.webp@ (when finished put on gold; around age up)

After 4th @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@ is built + 60 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, move @resource/resource_stone.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ (all 3 stragglers)

Set @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ till ~18 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ then start @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ till castle (unless committing feudal)

Research @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@@technology_economy/horticulture.webp@ and whichever @technology_byzantines/silk-road-mercenary-contract-1.webp@ (usually longbow if feudal push jav if castle)
@unit_byzantines/keshik-2.webp@ + @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@ to conscriptio ASAP | ctrl group 3 @resource/sheep.webp@ | shift-click @resource/berrybush.webp@ >@resource/sheep.webp@

Send @unit_worker/villager.webp@to @resource/resource_food.webp@, rally @resource/rally.webp@ rally on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 3. First @unit_worker/villager.webp@ builds @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@.
Rally @resource/rally.webp@ back on to @resource/resource_food.webp@ until enough resources to build @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@.
Transfer two additional @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@, one to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@, the other to @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
The two @unit_worker/villager.webp@ building @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@ should be queued to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@.
Keep @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@ until ready to go @age/age_3.webp@.

If the enemy is making units, skip @building_military/barracks.webp@and build a @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ , send 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to make a single trip to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ for @technology_defensive/arrow-slits.webp@.
Send  free @unit_lancaster/lord_lancaster.webp@ to defend @resource/resource_gold.webp@ or harass enemy @resource/resource_gold.webp@ if possible.

Send 10 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.webp@(9 @unit_worker/villager.webp@) and @resource/resource_wood.webp@ (1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@) to build @landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@ to protect @resource/resource_gold.webp@ + @resource/boar.webp@ / @resource/deer.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@ if possible.

The @unit_worker/villager.webp@ building @landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@ should be queued to go to build @building_economy/mill.webp@ and harvest new @resource/deer.webp@/@resource/boar.webp@ or @resource/berrybush.webp@.
If not able to secure @resource/resource_food.webp@, you can be vulnerable to raids and risk running out of food.

Leave 4  @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@, sending one to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and the rest to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and rally @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until the end of the game.

Build more @unit_lancaster/lord_lancaster.webp@ from @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@ and send with the 3 free @unit_lancaster/elitechampion.webp@ from @landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@ to kill villager with ranged shot + harass.
Start producing @unit_lancaster/elitechampion.webp@ from @building_military/barracks.webp@ to keep harassing.
Wounded units can go to @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@ and restore HP
One @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ builds a house, then back to @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
Another @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ builds a @building_religious/monastery.webp@ then back to @resource/resource_wood.webp@. @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@

Start producing @unit_religious/monk-3.webp@ to gather @resource/relics.webp@.  Send one @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ for @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ and @technology_military/wedge-rivets.webp@ + @technology_military/military-academy.webp@ + @technology_military/bloomery.webp@ @technology_military/decarbonization.webp@ + @technology_military/siege-engineering.webp@.

Send one @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to build a @building_economy/house.webp@ and second @building_military/barracks.webp@ to produce more @unit_lancaster/elitechampion.webp@.

Start building @building_military/archery-range.webp@ to produce @unit_lancaster/yeoman_age2.webp@ to counter their @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@. Get some @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to build @building_lancaster/manor.webp@.  Research @technology_lancaster/condensed_land_practices.webp@@technology_lancaster/open_field_system.webp@ as needed.

notes: Build mill, 7th vill builds village and goes to food
3 food vills build imperial academy, BBQ workers on wood, rally to wood
Move gold vills to wood after having 50 gold for IO
Drop 1st stable. Landmark vills back to food, rally to wood, build IO
After 10 wood vills, rally to stone, make 3rd IO
Drop 1st barracks, make a few spears to protect
Research wheelbarrow, make a few more units
Drop 2nd TC on deer to secure safe food, move 3 food vills to gold + rally to gold (2 vills)
Rally starting TC to wood, 2nd TC to deer
*Around 9:05, you should have this vill allocation on 2 TCs AND units on the map for harass*
Start researching all your eco upgrades (double broadax, forestry, survival techniques, horticulture, acid distillation, imperial examinations)
Build 3-4 archery ranges, start spamming out zhuge nu for a late feudal push or to defend a push, build 4th IO
After 20 on wood, rally both TCs on food. Build blacksmith and start researching upgrades
When you have about 35 vills on food, rally BOTH TCs to wood until about 35
You should have enough to age up, start walling the map. Rally BOTH TCs to gold
Once you are castle, you should have excess gold to start getting your tier 2 eco upgrades, military techs on your zhuge nu and spears, and make monks to get the relics that remain on the map
Once you have 15 on gold, rally both TCs to wood and start working on your farm transition as you'll have exhausted both deer packs, both berry bushes and 1 boar so you need farms

Make 1 @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ from @landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.png@ and garrison it inside of @building_military/stable.png@.
Send at least 1 or 2  @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@ to each enemy, don't attack always the same.
If one of them builds @building_defensive/outpost.png@, you can destroy it with (at least) 9 @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.png@ after @technology_military/iron-undermesh.png@ is researched.
and @technology_military/steeled-arrow.png@@technology_military/fitted-leatherwork.png@ on the second one (order matters!)
@unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ only role are to scare @unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@ away and to build @building_defensive/palisade-wall.png@, but you can eventually gather a decent mass of them.
Move both @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ out to capture @resource/sacred_sites.png@ just as @technology_delhi/sanctity.png@ is about to be completed.

Don't fight too hard for @resource/sacred_sites.png@. Use them as a distraction, forcing the enemies to move out of their base and creating more opportunitites to raid. Obviously the extra @resource/resource_gold.png@ is nice.
If @resource/sacred_sites.png@ are contested frequently, put some @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ to gather @resource/resource_gold.png@
Build @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ with @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ to defend your base or to block @resource/relics.png@.
If you are playing in a closed map, you can even wall your opponents inside of their bases.
If you are getting raided by cavalry, build @building_military/barracks.webp@ and train @unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@ to defend and wall your base.
Make @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ to steal @resource/deer.png@ from the opponent's side of the map, securing food and delaying the farm transition.
<- Reallocate villagers to something similar to this.
Attack quickly and frequently to prevent the opponents from aging up to @age/age_4.webp@.
Build 1 @building_military/siege-workshop.png@ and garrison 1 @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ inside. That will be enough until late @age/age_4.png@.
Depending on how defensive the enemies are playing:
@building_defensive/keep.webp@ in your base to defend against a counterattack while you get upgrades.
@building_defensive/keep.png@ to protect key resources in the middle of the map.
Build @building_defensive/stone-wall.png@ with infantry to protect your base.
3 @building_defensive/keep.png@ is a good amount to stop gathering @resource/resource_stone.png@.
<- Ideal economy (for now) should look like this
@landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.webp@ for faster tempo (faster late game upgrades) and better food economy. Allows you to liberate population space for a bigger army.
@landmark_delhi/palace-of-the-sultan.png@ good when constantly fighting/trading units with the opponents.
Make @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ up to 20, but don't build more @building_religious/mosque.png@.
Garrison @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside @landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.png@/@building_technology/madrasa.png@ (including the 3 that spawn outside of it).
After unit upgrades and economic technologies are completed: Garrison @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside military buildings.
Build @building_defensive/stone-wall.webp@ with your units as you push into the opponent's side of the map to protect reinforcements and control resources.

notes: @unit_cavalry/scout.png@ make sure to scout as much as you can. Especially your neighbours and the center.
@age/age_2.png@ Age up in ECO in House of Wisdom@landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@ -> @landmark_abbasid/economic-wing.png@.
NOTE: Make sure you don't have unneccessary villagers Q'd up, preventing you from ageing up around this time.
Don't forget to always keep at least 1 villager Q'd up in you TC, during your age up.
> Adjust your Eco as soon as you click up.
Take 8x @resource/resource_food.webp@ from Berries @resource/berrybush.png@ -> @resource/resource_wood.png@ wood to@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ around your TC.
> Take 5 vil's on straggler trees. Build a @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@mining camp on stone@resource/resource_stone.png@, as soon you have the wood.
You need to wait until you can effort it.
Collect stone @resource/resource_stone.png@, until you have 460. (Enough for 2 TC's in Feudal, with your unique Tech in House of Wisdom)
Keep Rallying @resource/rally.webp@  X Villagers on Wood@resource/resource_wood.png@, until you can effort your first and second TC.
Build a  lumber camp@building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ with one willager from the straggler trees, already collecting wood.
> Use 5 Villagers from Wood @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to place you first TC@building_economy/town-center.png@ on a ressource you want to secure.
> Use 5 Villagers from Stone @resource/resource_stone.png@ to place your second TC @building_economy/town-center.png@.
> Switch Rally point @resource/rally.png@ from Home TC to food@resource/resource_food.png@.

> At this point you are wide open and slightly vulnerable, but don't worry to much if you lose something, since most people are on one TC. You are on 3 TC's easily effording production on all of them.

Wood is really important for you defending possible attacks and repairing your buildings, building towers or building a single barracks nearby, secondly food to keep your villager production running and producing spearman.
> Make sure you always kept scouting your opponents. or you have at least vision towards them (Tower or 1 scout).
Therefore you can react to possible attacks.
> Get an equal amount of Villager numbers on Food, Wood and Gold.
> In general effort at least one Barracks to defend yourself, until Castle.
> Produce some Spearman to defend yourself 6x @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, until you reach castle.
> Get melee upgrades in Forge @building_technology/blacksmith.png@ and Barracks @building_military/barracks.png@. - Otherwise your units are low quality paper

I think you can choose between millitary wing@landmark_abbasid/military-wing.webp@ or culture wing@landmark_abbasid/culture-wing.png@. Since you have a lot of open upgrades at this point, i think culture Wing might boost you, getting everything in castle much easier and therefore faster@technology_abbasid/preservation-of-knowledge.png@. Your advancing to Imperial age becomes cheaper too.
> Again: Effort more than just a single forge@building_technology/blacksmith.webp@, otherwise your techs will take so much time and your army is going to be paper.
> Get all your melee millitary upgrades first and then your eco upgrades.
> Get Information on the map, Map control and Fight. @unit_cavalry/scout.png@@building_defensive/outpost.png@
> Age up as soon as you can to Imperial.
keep getting Information on the map, Map control and Fight. @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@@building_defensive/outpost.png@

In Imperial Age @age/age_4.webp@and in your House of Wisdom @landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@. name: Japanese | Feudal all-in
author: Jockxtar

notes: We need to chop 2 entire @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ before building a @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@
@unit_japanese/shinobi-2.webp@ role will be to use sabotage on enemy production buildings, nothing more. Once they do that, retreat them to safety.

Upgrade and produce @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to counter their cavalry. Keep a few protecting your @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@, move the rest to help in the all-in.
6 @unit_japanese/shinobi-2.webp@ is enough to constantly sabotage up to 3 production buildings. But, because they might die during fights, it's best to have at least 9.
Prioritize @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ over @unit_japanese/samurai-1.webp@, as they are more useful at both killing @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ and ranged units.

While you mass a decently sized army, focus on blocking resources such as @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and @resource/resource_stone.webp@, and sabotage production buildings with @unit_japanese/shinobi-2.webp@.

To do this, move the @unit_japanese/samurai-1.webp@ first to tank the @building_economy/town-center.webp@ shots, then move the @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ to force enemy ranged units away or get some @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ kills. Last, move the @unit_japanese/shinobi-2.webp@ to use the sabotage skill.
Don't fully dive the enemy @building_economy/town-center.webp@ too soon or you will not be able to reach critical mass.
When you start to gather from @resource/deer.webp@ and @resource/boar.webp@, research @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@
@building_economy/town-center.webp@ cancel all @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ on queue and research @technology_japanese/daimyo-manor-1.webp@

@technology_japanese/tatara-1.webp@+@technology_japanese/hizukuri-2.webp@+@unit_japanese/uma-bannerman-2.webp@ aura allows @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ to reach killing breakpoints on @unit_worker/villager-japanese.webp@ even if they have @technology_economy/textiles.webp@ (6 hits with it, 4 hits without it). This makes them really strong raiders.

Once the @unit_japanese/uma-bannerman-2.webp@ reaches the @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ army, it's the perfect moment to go for the dive. Focus production buildings first, then @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ and then additional @building_economy/town-center.webp@ before going for the main @building_economy/town-center.webp@.
With excess @resource/resource_wood.webp@ build a second @building_military/stable.webp@ and a second @building_military/barracks.webp@
If you see an angle to finish the opponent, research @technology_military/siege-engineering.webp@ and build 2 @unit_siege/battering-ram.webp@.

You can put @unit_japanese/shinobi-2.webp@ inside @unit_siege/battering-ram.webp@ to protect them against @building_economy/town-center.webp@ fire while waiting for a new round of sabotages on the enemy production.
If you can't quite finish off the opponent and end up with a high bank of @resource/resource_gold.webp@, stop producing units for a bit and age up @age/age_3.webp@
@landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@ to boost production further and research veteran upgrade for @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ quicker.
Research veteran upgrade for @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ and @unit_japanese/samurai-1.webp@, @technology_military/wedge-rivets.webp@ and @technology_japanese/kobuse-gitae-3.webp@
That's all you should need to close the game by simply torching down enemy landmarks.

Block enemy production with shinobis' sabotage abilty and win by simply outnumbering the opponent.

author: Jockxtar

notes: The ideal position for @landmark_malians/saharan-trade-network-1.png@ is the closest point to your base that's in the future trade route.
This build plays around trade for the extra gold economy. This landmark provides protection and extra value to the @unit_worker/trader.png@.
You will need at least 4 @unit_malians/donso-1.png@ to protect yourself from early raids

1 @unit_worker/villager-malians.webp@ -> 2nd @building_malians/pit-mine-1.png@ with full @building_economy/house.png@ and @building_economy/mining-camp.png@ around it (keep them mining @resource/resource_gold.png@ there)
6 @unit_malians/donso-1.png@ and 6 @unit_malians/javelin-thrower-2.png@ should be enough to defend yourself from early harassment.
If you scout an opponent is going to all-in you, make more units that properly counter their army and ask for help until you have numbers advantage.
Produce @resource/cattle.webp@ from @building_economy/mill.png@ as you get the @resource/resource_gold.png@
@abilities/repair.webp@2@building_economy/market.png@ and start making @unit_worker/trader.png@ only after securing your base with units and/or @building_defensive/palisade-wall.png@.

Remember to build @building_malians/toll-outpost-1.png@ in the trade route to defend and boost your trade, but make sure their influence areas don't overlap or you won't gain the bonus @resource/resource_gold.png@ and @resource/resource_food.png@!!
Research @technology_economy/horticulture.webp@ after you run out of @resource/deer.png@ and move to @resource/berrybush.png@
Stop producing @resource/cattle.png@ and @unit_worker/trader.png@ when you feel ready to @age/age_3.png@
@resource/rally.png@ -> @resource/resource_food.png@ (16) {If you run out of @resource/berrybush.png@ and @resource/deer.png@, build @building_economy/farm.png@}

First 30 @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ ; then 20 @unit_malians/donso-1.png@ and/or @unit_malians/musofadi-warrior-2.png@ depending on how the opponent decides to counter your @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@, although @unit_malians/donso-1.png@ are always nice to have around in case any enemy decides to flank your army with cavalry.

If they make mass ranged units, you can make one or two @unit_siege/mangonel-3.png@ to break them. Still, with good micro, the poison arrows and the high production speed should be enough to win you the fight.
Produce @unit_malians/warrior-scout-2.webp@ from stables and slowly transition into @unit_malians/sofa-2.png@ as you get more @unit_worker/trader.png@.
These units will work as a meat shield for your infantry and maybe even force the opponent into making @unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@

Don't forget to research all economic upgrades and build more @building_military/barracks.webp@, @building_military/archery-range.png@ & @building_military/stable.png@ (5 of each is ok for now but as you get more @unit_worker/trader.png@ you will need more)
Don't produce @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ from @building_military/archery-range.png@ at first, spend the @resource/resource_wood.png@ on buildings.
Choose an opponent and all-in them. If you are not able to finish them off completely, ask an ally to send a few troops to aid you.
You should win any 1v1 and 2v2 if you produce the right units and keep your @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ mass high enough.

Build @unit_siege/battering-ram.png@ to destroy buildings for more permanent damage. Prioritize additional @building_economy/town-center.png@ then @building_military/barracks.png@, @building_military/archery-range.png@ & @building_military/stable.png@
If the all-in fails, @building_defensive/stone-wall.webp@ your base and start raiding with @unit_malians/sofa-2.png@.
Send the rest of your army to support your allies wherever they go.
If you get attacked, ask your allies for help.

@landmark_malians/fort-of-the-huntress-3.webp@ is a good choice if your team has control of a key area in the map. Rally your reinforcements wherever you build it so that they will be safe until you decide to make them join the rest of the army or go to a different location to defend.
It's also ok if you desperately need a keep in your base to defend from an inminent attack, but remember that it has the stats of a regular @building_defensive/keep.png@.

@landmark_malians/griot-bara-3.webp@ has two unique active abilities that can help a lot at replenishing lost army and a third one that's very powerful to finish off opponents by giving your units additional siege damage.
If your team doesn't have map control or things between both teams are even, this landmark will be more useful.
Your role at this stage of the game will be to defend your team's side of the map and support your allies in combat.
Don't forget to raid the enemies' economy and wall areas with important resources.

description:
Trade build for team games. Play defensive at the beginning like usual and make cows.
Start producing traders only when it's safe to do so (you have a big enough standing army and/or good walls).
This build order works well in closed maps where you can take a bit more time to ramp up your trade eco and catch enemies off-guard by making more than 30 units in 3 minutes (yep, Farimba is that insane).

name: ToV Feudal Rush into Castle Push
author: Fumblez

notes: 1 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ starts@building_economy/mill.png@ and goes to build @building_religious/mosque.png@ (queue @technology_delhi/efficient-production.png@ first) / 5 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ to straggler @resource/resource_wood.png@
2 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to chopped straggler @resource/resource_wood.png@, then 1 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ to build @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@
Pull @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ at 3770G in Gold Vein onto @resource/resource_wood.png@  -> Queue @unit_delhi/scholar.png@

Rally @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ back to @resource/resource_food.png@. Build @building_technology/blacksmith.png@. Then either build a second @building_technology/blacksmith.png@ immediately if space or   @building_military/archery-range.png@ if under pressure
QUEUE MOSQUE TECHS. Prioritize @technology_delhi/sanctity.webp@, then @technology_delhi/all-seeing-eye.png@, then @technology_religious/piety.png@

@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ split should be heavier on @resource/resource_wood.png@ initially to get down @building_technology/blacksmith.png@ + prod buildings (make @building_military/stable.png@ or @building_military/barracks.png@ + @building_military/archery-range.png@). Garrison @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ in prod buildings to spam units
Now balance economy approx 50/50 to build @resource/resource_food.webp@+@resource/resource_wood.png@heavy units and @building_defensive/palisade-wall.png@around @resource/sacred_sites.png@.

Remove @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ from prod. buildings and send to @resource/sacred_sites.png@. It's okay to split units for sites so long as you aren't losing too many. Make @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ from @resource/sacred_sites.png@ @resource/resource_gold.png@
At this point, producing out of ~3 @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and 2 @building_military/barracks.png@ (w/ 1 @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ garrisoned)

CASTLE TIMING - Use @landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.webp@ (not if opponent is in castle): build 3-4 @building_military/barracks.png@ (total with scholars) and mass@unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.png@. Send age up vills to @resource/resource_stone.png@and @building_defensive/keep.png@-drop opponents base when pushing. Go siege, if necessary, and, if you can't push, build economy with @building_defensive/keep.png@. Valdemar drops his @landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.png@ at around 15:50 (this changes based on game state) using 12 villagers from wood. Only ever go @landmark_delhi/house-of-learning.png@ if you are very late/the last person to reach castle (maybe 5% of games)
Of course, scout opponent and build units that counter his. This is just a guide.
SCHOLARS - Shoot for 10-12 @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ in castle and ~20 @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ in imperial to get techs in a reasonable amount of time.

author: taktaktab

notes: 1 Vill builds @building_military/barracks.webp@ , 2 Vills to @resource/sheep.webp@, 2 Vills to @resource/resource_wood.webp@

Produce 2@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ from @building_military/barracks.webp@ (could go for 3@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ if needed*)

once we have 75 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ we get @technology_japanese/towara-1.webp@ and move one @resource/resource_wood.webp@ vill to build @building_japanese/forge-1.webp@ by the @resource/resource_gold.webp@
once @building_japanese/forge-1.webp@ is done send the builder Vill to@resource/resource_gold.webp@  and move 2 vills from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@

Note: Try to save your 2-3 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to defend vs any cav that tries to harras your @resource/resource_gold.webp@. if this is not possible then invest 1-2 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ Vills into @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to make either a @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ or more @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ based on what the opponent is building.
(The rest of this guide assumes that we did not need to move any Vills to @resource/resource_wood.webp@)*

Once @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@ is done, move the 2 builder Vills to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Age up with 8 @resource/sheep.webp@ Vills and build @landmark_japanese/floating-gate-2.webp@
(We Need 200  @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for a @building_japanese/farmhouse-1.webp@ and then a @building_military/stable.webp@)

Note: Continue to move @resource/sheep.webp@Vills to @landmark_japanese/kura-storehouse-1.webp@@building_economy/farm.webp@ when they become available

Once @building_military/stable.webp@ is done, put @ability_japanese/ability-place-yorishiro.webp@ in @building_military/stable.webp@ and make @unit_japanese/uma-bannerman-2.webp@/@unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@

Grab @resource/relics.webp@ and if opponent is passive (you have map controll) get @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ and raid with @unit_japanese/uma-bannerman-2.webp@/@unit_japanese/mounted-samurai-3.webp@
Continue the rest of the game and make sure to macro based on your needs:

description:
This build order inspired by Vortix's Rush+Fast Castle Build Order but it has been changed to make it easier for beginners (therfore it is easier to follow but most likely worse than the original build). 
The main difference is that we go on barry as soon as Tawara upgrade is done, we do this to preserve sheep for a safe food source vs raiding civs.

author: Flip

notes: Three starting @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ go on @resource/resource_gold.webp@, build @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ with 1.

Drop off food (should be able to queue 3 vills now), take all 5 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ and @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/mill.webp@ on @resource/deer.webp@. Research @technology_jin/mohe-ancestry.webp@.

@resource/rally.webp@ next @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@. When you have 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/house.webp@ and go on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ with these vills.
You will have enough to age up with @landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@. Take 2 from @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and rally 1 more from TC.

Then @resource/rally.webp@ to the already cut straggler tree to gather 100 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for @building_jin/grassland.webp@. These villagers will move to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ after finishing the tree, so you can shift-queue the rally point from the tree to the gold.
When the tree finishes,  @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ (next straggler) for the next 3 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@, we will need a @building_economy/house.webp@.

tactics.title: 3 stone vs French / Jeanne / Malians, not vs spears
tactics.detail: Valdemar’s default 3-stone: French, Jeanne, Malians, plus China (spears are weak there). Three vills on exposed stone die to a spear rush — then switch to the mill BO. Vs French/Jeanne YOU may make spears vs their knights and age with 2–3 vills; they are not spear openers.

tactics.title: Age up 4 vs China; 2–3 if you spear vs knights
tactics.detail: One gold villager banks the entire Dark Age. 4 vs China. Default 3. Age with 2 if YOU queue spears vs French/Jeanne royal knights — that is your counter, not their opener.

tactics.title: Stone only for four cisterns
tactics.detail: Pull stone at 100, drop the 4th cistern, then stragglers to 8 wood. Extra stone just floats.

tactics.title: Center cistern research, others production
tactics.detail: Flip the middle cistern to research and the rest to production speed before Feudal production.

tactics.title: Play like English: longbow wood harass
tactics.detail: Do not dive a barbican. Longbows are cheaper — queue four. Secure three berry patches, then Castle. Song Dynasty into this is a free win.

tactics.title: Stop units at 11:00, Castle ~12–13 min
tactics.detail: 2–3 on wood, rest food/gold. Golden Horn + stable, cistern-scaled upgrades, then the damage window.

[02:51] Castle around 12 minutes. Mill opener is useful now; Triumph is very powerful.

[09:36] He went Song — the game is over.

description: Vortix's Principality of Antioch (Serjeants) and the Kingdom of Castile (Genitour) build. This strategy focuses on a potent mid-game composition of Serjeant+Spearmen+Genitour to counter diverse enemy unit types. Goes Pilgrim then 2nd TC into Castle Age. Uses healing and damage bonuses of Castilian influence near holy sites.
